title: Exodus 36:7
text: For the material they had was enough and more than enough for all the work which had to be done.

title: Exodus 36:8
text: ¶Then all the expert workmen among them made the House with its ten curtains; of the best linen, blue and purple and red, they made them, with winged ones worked by expert designers.

title: Exodus 36:9
text: Every curtain was twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide, all of the same measure.

title: Exodus 36:10
text: And five curtains were joined together, and the other five curtains were joined together.

title: Exodus 36:11
text: And they put twists of blue cord on the edge of the outside curtain of the first group, and in the same way on the outside curtain of the second group.

title: Exodus 36:12
text: Fifty twists on the one curtain and fifty on the edge of the curtain of the other group; the twists being opposite to one another.

title: Exodus 36:13
text: And they made fifty hooks of gold, joining the curtains one to another with the hooks; and so the House was made.

title: Exodus 36:14
text: ¶And they made curtains of goats' hair for the tent; eleven curtains were made.

title: Exodus 36:15
text: Every curtain was thirty cubits long and four cubits wide, all of the same measure.

title: Exodus 36:16
text: Five curtains were joined together to make one group, and six curtains were joined together to make the other group.

title: Exodus 36:17
text: And they put fifty twists of cord on the edge of the outside curtain of the first group, and fifty twists on the edge of the outside curtain of the second group,

title: Exodus 36:18
text: And fifty hooks of brass for joining them together to make the tent.

title: Exodus 36:19
text: And they made a cover of sheepskins coloured red, to go over the tent, and a cover of leather over that.

title: Exodus 36:20
text: And for the uprights of the House they made boards of hard wood.

title: Exodus 36:21
text: The boards were ten cubits long and one cubit and a half wide.

title: Exodus 36:22
text: Every board had two tongues fixed into it; all the boards were made in this way.

title: Exodus 36:23
text: They made twenty boards for the south side of the House:

title: Exodus 36:24
text: And for these twenty boards, forty silver bases, two bases under every board, to take its tongues.

title: Exodus 36:25
text: And for the second side of the House, on the north, they made twenty boards,

title: Exodus 36:26
text: With their forty silver bases, two bases for every board.

title: Exodus 36:27
text: And for the west side of the House, at the back, they made six boards,

title: Exodus 36:28
text: And two boards for the angles at the back.

title: Exodus 36:29
text: These were joined together at the base and at the top to one ring, so forming the two angles.

title: Exodus 36:30
text: So there were eight boards with sixteen bases of silver, two bases under every board.

title: Exodus 36:31
text: And they made rods of hard wood; five for the boards on one side of the House,

title: Exodus 36:32
text: And five for the boards on the other side of the House, and five for the boards at the back, on the west.

title: Exodus 36:33
text: The middle rod was made to go right through the rings of all the boards from one end to the other.

title: Exodus 36:34
text: All the boards were plated with gold, and the rings through which the rods went were of gold, and the rods were plated with gold.

title: Exodus 36:35
text: ¶And he made the veil of the best linen, blue and purple and red, worked with winged ones designed by expert workmen.

title: Exodus 36:36
text: And they made four pillars for it of hard wood plated with gold: they had hooks of gold and four silver bases.

title: Exodus 36:37
text: And they made a curtain for the door of the tent, of the best linen with needlework of blue and purple and red;

title: Exodus 36:38
text: And five pillars for the curtain, with their hooks; the heads of the pillars were of gold and they were circled with bands of gold; and their five bases were of brass.

title: Exodus 37:1
text: ¶And Bezalel made the ark of hard wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide and a cubit and a half high;

title: Exodus 37:2
text: Plating it inside and out with the best gold, and putting an edge of gold all round it.

title: Exodus 37:3
text: And he made four gold rings for its four angles, two on one side and two on the other,

title: Exodus 37:4
text: And rods of the same wood plated with gold.

title: Exodus 37:5
text: These rods he put in the rings at the sides of the ark, for lifting it.

title: Exodus 37:6
text: And he made the cover all of gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

title: Exodus 37:7
text: And he made two winged ones, hammered out of one bit of gold, for the two ends of the cover;

title: Exodus 37:8
text: Placing one at one end and one at the other; the winged ones were part of the cover.

title: Exodus 37:9
text: And their wings were stretched out over the cover; the faces of the winged ones were opposite one another and facing the cover.

title: Exodus 37:10
text: ¶And he made the table of hard wood, two cubits long, a cubit wide and a cubit and a half high;

title: Exodus 37:11
text: Plating it with the best gold and putting a gold edge all round it.

title: Exodus 37:12
text: And he made a frame all round it about as wide as a man's hand, edged with gold all round.

title: Exodus 37:13
text: And he made four gold rings, and put the rings at the angles of its four feet.

title: Exodus 37:14
text: The rings were fixed under the frame to take the rods with which the table was to be lifted.

title: Exodus 37:15
text: The rods for lifting the table he made of hard wood plated with gold.

title: Exodus 37:16
text: And all the table-vessels, the plates and spoons and basins and the cups for liquids, he made of the best gold.

title: Exodus 37:17
text: Then he made the support for the lights, all of the best gold; its base and its pillar were of hammered gold; its cups and buds and flowers were all made out of the same metal:

title: Exodus 37:18
text: It had six branches coming out from its sides, three from one side and three from the other;

title: Exodus 37:19
text: Every branch having three cups made like almond flowers, every cup with a bud and a flower on all the branches;

title: Exodus 37:20
text: And on its pillar, four cups like almond flowers, every one with its bud and its flower;

title: Exodus 37:21
text: And under every two branches a bud, made with the branch, for all six branches of it.

title: Exodus 37:22
text: The buds and the branches were made of the same metal, all together one complete work of the best hammered gold.

title: Exodus 37:23
text: And he made the seven vessels for the lights, and all the necessary instruments for it, of gold.

title: Exodus 37:24
text: A talent of the best gold was used for the making of it and its vessels.

title: Exodus 37:25
text: ¶And he made the altar for the burning of spices, using the same hard wood; it was square, a cubit long and a cubit wide and two cubits high; the horns made of the same.

title: Exodus 37:26
text: The top and the sides and the horns were all plated with the best gold; and he put an edge of gold all round it.

title: Exodus 37:27
text: And he made two gold rings, placing them on the two opposite sides under the edge, to take the rods for lifting it.

title: Exodus 37:28
text: The rods he made of the same hard wood, plating them with gold.

title: Exodus 37:29
text: And he made the holy oil and the perfume of sweet spices for burning, after the art of the perfume-maker.

title: Exodus 38:1
text: ¶The altar of burned offerings he made of hard wood; a square altar, five cubits long, five cubits wide and three cubits high,

title: Exodus 38:2
text: And he put horns at its four angles made of the same, plating it all with brass;

title: Exodus 38:3
text: And brass was used for all the vessels of the altar, the baskets and the spades, the basins and the meat-hooks and the fire-trays; all the vessels he made of brass

title: Exodus 38:4
text: And he made a network of brass for the altar, under the frame round it, stretching half-way up;

title: Exodus 38:5
text: And four rings for the four angles of this network, to take the rods.

title: Exodus 38:6
text: The rods he made of hard wood plated with brass.

title: Exodus 38:7
text: He put the rods through the rings at the opposite sides of the altar for lifting it; he made the altar hollow, boarded in with wood.

title: Exodus 38:8
text: And he made the washing-vessel of brass on a brass base, using the polished brass looking-glasses given by the women who did work at the doors of the Tent of meeting.

title: Exodus 38:9
text: ¶To make the open space, he put hangings on the south side, of the best linen, a hundred cubits long:

title: Exodus 38:10
text: Their twenty pillars and their twenty bases were brass; and the hooks of the pillars and their bands were of silver.

title: Exodus 38:11
text: And for the north side. hangings a hundred cubits long, on twenty brass pillars in brass bases, with silver hooks and bands.

title: Exodus 38:12
text: And on the west side, hangings fifty cubits long, on ten pillars in ten bases, with silver bands.

title: Exodus 38:13
text: And on the east side, the open space was fifty cubits long.

title: Exodus 38:14
text: The hangings on one side of the doorway were fifteen cubits long, on three pillars with their three bases;

title: Exodus 38:15
text: And the same on the other side of the doorway; on this side and on that the hangings were fifteen cubits long, on three pillars with their three bases.

title: Exodus 38:16
text: All the hangings were of the best linen.

title: Exodus 38:17
text: And the bases of the pillars were of brass; their hooks and the bands round the tops of them were of silver; all the pillars were ringed with silver.

title: Exodus 38:18
text: And the curtain for the doorway of the open space was of the best linen, with designs of blue and purple and red in needlework; it was twenty cubits long and five cubits high, to go with the hangings round the sides.

title: Exodus 38:19
text: There were four pillars with their bases, all of brass, the hooks being of silver, and their tops and their bands being covered with silver.

title: Exodus 38:20
text: All the nails used for the House and the open space round it were of brass.

title: Exodus 38:21
text: ¶This is the price of the making of the House, even the House of witness, as it was valued by the word of Moses, for the work of the Levites under the direction of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

title: Exodus 38:22
text: Bezalel, the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made everything as the Lord had given orders to Moses.

title: Exodus 38:23
text: And with him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; a designer and a trained workman, expert in needlework of blue and purple and red and the best linen.

title: Exodus 38:24
text: The gold used for all the different work done for the holy place, the gold which was given, was twenty-nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels in weight, by the scale of the holy place.

title: Exodus 38:25
text: And the silver given by those who were numbered of the people was a hundred talents, and a thousand, seven hundred and seventy-five shekels in weight, by the scale of the holy place.

title: Exodus 38:26
text: A beka, that is, half a shekel by the holy scale, for everyone who was numbered; there were six hundred and three thousand, five hundred and fifty men of twenty years old and over.

title: Exodus 38:27
text: Of this silver, a hundred talents was used for making the bases of the pillars of the holy place and of the veil; a talent for every base.

title: Exodus 38:28
text: And a thousand, seven hundred and seventy-five shekels of silver was used to make the hooks for the pillars, and for plating the tops of the pillars and for making their bands.

title: Exodus 38:29
text: The brass which was given was seventy talents, two thousand four hundred shekels;

title: Exodus 38:30
text: From it he made the bases of the doorway of the Tent of meeting and the brass altar and the network for it and all the vessels for the altar,

title: Exodus 38:31
text: And the bases for the open space all round and for its doorway, and all the nails for the House and for the open space.

title: Exodus 39:1
text: ¶And from the needlework of blue and purple and red they made the robes used for the work of the holy place, and the holy robes for Aaron, as the Lord had given orders to Moses.

title: Exodus 39:2
text: The ephod he made of gold and blue and purple and red and the best linen;

title: Exodus 39:3
text: Hammering the gold into thin plates and cutting it into wires to be worked into the blue and the purple and the red and the linen by the designer.

title: Exodus 39:4
text: And they made two bands for joining its edges together at the top of the arms.

title: Exodus 39:5
text: And the beautifully worked band which went on it was of the same design and the same material, worked in gold and blue and purple and red and twisted linen-work, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

title: Exodus 39:6
text: Then they made the beryl stones, fixed in twisted frames of gold and cut like the cutting of a stamp, with the names of the children of Israel.

title: Exodus 39:7
text: These he put on the ephod, over the arm-holes, to be stones of memory for the children of Israel, as the Lord had said to Moses.

title: Exodus 39:8
text: The priest's bag was designed like the ephod, of the best linen worked with gold and blue and purple and red.

title: Exodus 39:9
text: It was square and folded in two, as long and as wide as the stretch of a man's hand;

title: Exodus 39:10
text: And on it they put four lines of stones: in the first line was a carnelian, a chrysolite, and an emerald;

title: Exodus 39:11
text: In the second, a ruby, a sapphire, and an onyx;

title: Exodus 39:12
text: In the third, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

title: Exodus 39:13
text: In the fourth, a topaz, a beryl, and a jasper; they were fixed in twisted frames of gold.

title: Exodus 39:14
text: There were twelve stones for the twelve tribes of Israel; on every one the name of one of the tribes of Israel was cut, like the cutting of a stamp.

title: Exodus 39:15
text: And on the bag they put gold chains, twisted like cords.

title: Exodus 39:16
text: And they made two gold frames and two gold rings, the rings being fixed to the ends of the priest's bag;

title: Exodus 39:17
text: And they put the two twisted chains on the two rings at the ends of the priest's bag;

title: Exodus 39:18
text: And the other two ends of the chains were joined to the two frames and fixed to the front of the ephod over the arm-holes.

title: Exodus 39:19
text: And they made two rings of gold and put them on the two lower ends of the bag, on the inner side nearest to the ephod.

title: Exodus 39:20
text: And two other gold rings were put on the front of the ephod, over the arm-holes, at the join, and over the worked band.

title: Exodus 39:21
text: And the rings on the bag were fixed to the rings of the ephod by a blue cord, keeping it in place over the band, so that the bag might not get loose, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

title: Exodus 39:22
text: The robe which went with the ephod was made all of blue;

title: Exodus 39:23
text: With a hole at the top in the middle, like the hole in the coat of a fighting-man, edged with a band to make it strong.

title: Exodus 39:24
text: The skirts of the robe were worked all round with fruits in blue and purple and red made of twisted linen.

title: Exodus 39:25
text: And between the fruits all round the skirt they put gold bells, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

title: Exodus 39:26
text: All round the skirt of the robe were bells and fruits in turn.

title: Exodus 39:27
text: The coats for Aaron and his sons they made of the best linen;

title: Exodus 39:28
text: And the twisted head-dress for Aaron, and beautiful head-dresses of linen, and linen trousers,

title: Exodus 39:29
text: And a linen band worked with a design of blue and purple and red, as the Lord had said to Moses.

title: Exodus 39:30
text: The plate for the holy crown was made of the best gold, and on it were cut these words, HOLY TO THE LORD.

title: Exodus 39:31
text: It was fixed to the head-dress by a blue cord, as the Lord had given orders to Moses.

title: Exodus 39:32
text: ¶So all the work on the House of the Tent of meeting was done; as the Lord had given orders to Moses, so the children of Israel did it.

title: Exodus 39:33
text: Then they took the House to Moses, the tent with all the things for it; its hooks, its boards, its rods, its pillars, and its bases;

title: Exodus 39:34
text: The outer cover of sheepskins coloured red, and the cover of leather, and the veil for the doorway;

title: Exodus 39:35
text: The ark of the law, with its rods and its cover;

title: Exodus 39:36
text: The table, with all its vessels and the holy bread;

title: Exodus 39:37
text: The support for the lights, with the vessels for the lights to be put in their places on it, and all its vessels, and the oil for the lights;

title: Exodus 39:38
text: And the gold altar, and the holy oil, and the sweet perfume for burning, and the curtain for the doorway of the tent;

title: Exodus 39:39
text: And the brass altar, with its network of brass, and its rods and all its vessels, and the washing-vessel and its base;

title: Exodus 39:40
text: The hangings for the open space, with the pillars and their bases, and the curtain for the doorway, and the cords and nails, and all the instruments necessary for the work of the House of the Tent of meeting;

title: Exodus 39:41
text: The robes for use in the holy place, and the holy robes for Aaron and his sons when acting as priests.

title: Exodus 39:42
text: The children of Israel did everything as the Lord had given orders to Moses.

title: Exodus 39:43
text: Then Moses, when he saw all their work and saw that they had done everything as the Lord had said, gave them his blessing.

title: Exodus 40:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Exodus 40:2
text: On the first day of the first month you are to put up the House of the Tent of meeting.

title: Exodus 40:3
text: And inside it put the ark of the law, hanging the veil before it.

title: Exodus 40:4
text: And put the table inside, placing all the things on it in order; and put in the support for the lights, and let its lights be burning.

title: Exodus 40:5
text: And put the gold altar for burning perfumes in front of the ark of the law, hanging the curtain over the doorway of the House.

title: Exodus 40:6
text: And put the altar of burned offerings before the doorway of the House of the Tent of meeting.

title: Exodus 40:7
text: And let the washing-vessel, with water in it, be put between the Tent of meeting and the altar.

title: Exodus 40:8
text: And put up the hangings forming the open space all round it, with the curtain over its doorway.

title: Exodus 40:9
text: And take the holy oil and put it on the House and everything in it, and make it and everything in it holy:

title: Exodus 40:10
text: And put oil on the altar of burned offering, and make it and all its vessels holy; this altar is to be most holy.

title: Exodus 40:11
text: And put oil on the washing-vessel and its base, and make them holy.

title: Exodus 40:12
text: Then let Aaron and his sons come to the door of the Tent of meeting; and after washing them with water,

title: Exodus 40:13
text: You are to put on Aaron the holy robes; and you are to put oil on him, and make him holy, so that he may be my priest.

title: Exodus 40:14
text: And take his sons with him and put coats on them;

title: Exodus 40:15
text: And put oil on them as you did on their father, so that they may be my priests: the putting on of oil will make them priests for ever, from generation to generation.

title: Exodus 40:16
text: ¶And Moses did this; as the Lord gave him orders, so he did.

title: Exodus 40:17
text: So on the first day of the first month in the second year the House was put up.

title: Exodus 40:18
text: Moses put up the House; placing its bases in position and lifting up its uprights, putting in the rods and planting the pillars in their places;

title: Exodus 40:19
text: Stretching the outer tent over it, and covering it, as the Lord had given him orders.

title: Exodus 40:20
text: And he took the law and put it inside the ark, and put the rods at its side and the cover over it;

title: Exodus 40:21
text: And he took the ark into the House, hanging up the veil before it as the Lord had given him orders.

title: Exodus 40:22
text: And he put the table in the Tent of meeting, on the north side outside the veil.

title: Exodus 40:23
text: And he put the bread on it in order before the Lord, as the Lord had said.

title: Exodus 40:24
text: The support for the lights he put in the Tent of meeting, opposite the table, on the south side:

title: Exodus 40:25
text: Lighting the lights before the Lord, as the Lord had given him orders.

title: Exodus 40:26
text: And he put the gold altar in the Tent of meeting, in front of the veil:

title: Exodus 40:27
text: Burning sweet perfumes on it, as the Lord had given him orders.

title: Exodus 40:28
text: And he put up the curtain at the doorway of the House.

title: Exodus 40:29
text: And at the door of the House of the Tent of meeting, he put the altar of burned offerings, offering on it the burned offering and the meal offering, as the Lord had given him orders.

title: Exodus 40:30
text: And between the altar and the Tent of meeting he put the vessel with water in it for washing.

title: Exodus 40:31
text: In it the hands and feet of Moses and Aaron and his sons were washed,

title: Exodus 40:32
text: Whenever they went into the Tent of meeting, and when they came near the altar, as the Lord had given orders to Moses.

title: Exodus 40:33
text: And he put up the hangings forming the open space round the House and the altar, and put the curtain over the doorway. So Moses made the work complete.

title: Exodus 40:34
text: ¶Then the cloud came down covering the Tent of meeting, and the House was full of the glory of the Lord;

title: Exodus 40:35
text: So that Moses was not able to go into the Tent of meeting, because the cloud was resting on it, and the House was full of the glory of the Lord.

title: Exodus 40:36
text: And whenever the cloud was taken up from the House, the children of Israel went forward on their journey:

title: Exodus 40:37
text: But while the cloud was there, they made no move till it was taken up.

title: Exodus 40:38
text: For the cloud of the Lord was resting on the House by day, and at night there was fire in the cloud, before the eyes of all the people of Israel, and so it was through all their journeys.

title: Leviticus 1:1
text: ¶And the voice of the Lord came to Moses out of the Tent of meeting, saying,

title: Leviticus 1:2
text: Give these orders to the children of Israel: When anyone of you makes an offering to the Lord, you are to take it from the cattle, from the herd or from the flock.

title: Leviticus 1:3
text: ¶If the offering is a burned offering of the herd, let him give a male without a mark: he is to give it at the door of the Tent of meeting so that he may be pleasing to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 1:4
text: And he is to put his hand on the head of the burned offering and it will be taken for him, to take away his sin.

title: Leviticus 1:5
text: And the ox is to be put to death before the Lord: then Aaron's sons, the priests, are to take the blood and put some of it on and round the altar which is at the door of the Tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 1:6
text: And the burned offering is to be skinned and cut up into its parts.

title: Leviticus 1:7
text: And Aaron's sons, the priests, are to put fire on the altar and put the wood in order on the fire:

title: Leviticus 1:8
text: And Aaron's sons, the priests, are to put the parts, the head and the fat, in order on the wood which is on the fire on the altar:

title: Leviticus 1:9
text: But its inside parts and its legs are to be washed with water, and it will all be burned on the altar by the priest for a burned offering, an offering made by fire, for a sweet smell to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 1:10
text: ¶And if his offering is of the flock, a burned offering of sheep or goats, let him give a male without a mark.

title: Leviticus 1:11
text: And he is to put it to death on the north side of the altar before the Lord: and Aaron's sons, the priests, are to put some of the blood on and round the altar.

title: Leviticus 1:12
text: And the offering is to be cut into its parts, with its head and its fat; and the priest is to put them in order on the wood which is on the fire on the altar:

title: Leviticus 1:13
text: But the inside parts and the legs are to be washed with water; and the priest will make an offering of all of it, burning it on the altar: it is a burned offering, an offering made by fire, for a sweet smell to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 1:14
text: And if his offering to the Lord is a burned offering of birds, then he is to make his offering of doves or of young pigeons.

title: Leviticus 1:15
text: And the priest is to take it to the altar, and after its head has been twisted off, it is to be burned on the altar, and its blood drained out on the side of the altar:

title: Leviticus 1:16
text: And he is to take away its stomach, with its feathers, and put it down by the east side of the altar, where the burned waste is put:

title: Leviticus 1:17
text: And let it be broken open at the wings, but not cut in two; and let it be burned on the altar by the priest on the wood which is on the fire; it is a burned offering; an offering made by fire for a sweet smell to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 2:1
text: ¶And when anyone makes a meal offering to the Lord, let his offering be of the best meal, with oil on it and perfume:

title: Leviticus 2:2
text: And let him take it to Aaron's sons, the priests; and having taken in his hand some of the meal and of the oil, with all the perfume, let him give it to the priest to be burned on the altar, as a sign, an offering made by fire, for a sweet smell to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 2:3
text: And the rest of the meal offering will be for Aaron and his sons; it is most holy among the Lord's fire offerings.

title: Leviticus 2:4
text: And when you give a meal offering cooked in the oven, let it be of unleavened cakes of the best meal mixed with oil, or thin unleavened cakes covered with oil.

title: Leviticus 2:5
text: And if you give a meal offering cooked on a flat plate, let it be of the best meal, unleavened and mixed with oil.

title: Leviticus 2:6
text: Let it be broken into bits, and put oil on it; it is a meal offering.

title: Leviticus 2:7
text: And if your offering is of meal cooked in fat over the fire, let it be made of the best meal mixed with oil.

title: Leviticus 2:8
text: And you are to give the meal offering made of these things to the Lord, and let the priest take it to the altar.

title: Leviticus 2:9
text: And he is to take from the meal offering a part, for a sign, burning it on the altar; an offering made by fire for a sweet smell to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 2:10
text: And the rest of the meal offering will be for Aaron and his sons; it is most holy among the Lord's fire offerings.

title: Leviticus 2:11
text: ¶No meal offering which you give to the Lord is to be made with leaven; no leaven or honey is to be burned as an offering made by fire to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 2:12
text: You may give them as an offering of first-fruits to the Lord, but they are not to go up as a sweet smell on the altar.

title: Leviticus 2:13
text: And every meal offering is to be salted with salt; your meal offering is not to be without the salt of the agreement of your God: with all your offerings give salt.

title: Leviticus 2:14
text: And if you give a meal offering of first-fruits to the Lord, give, as your offering of first-fruits, new grain, made dry with fire, crushed new grain.

title: Leviticus 2:15
text: And put oil on it and perfume: it is a meal offering.

title: Leviticus 2:16
text: And part of the meal of the offering and part of the oil and all the perfume is to be burned for a sign by the priest: it is an offering made by fire to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 3:1
text: ¶And if his offering is given for a peace-offering; if he gives of the herd, male or female, let him give it without any mark on it, before the Lord.

title: Leviticus 3:2
text: And he is to put his hand on the head of his offering and put it to death at the door of the Tent of meeting; and Aaron's sons, the priests, are to put some of the blood on and round the altar.

title: Leviticus 3:3
text: And he is to give of the peace-offering, as an offering made by fire to the Lord; the fat covering the inside parts and all the fat on the inside parts,

title: Leviticus 3:4
text: And the two kidneys, and the fat on them, which is by the top part of the legs, and the fat joining the liver and the kidneys, he is to take away;

title: Leviticus 3:5
text: That it may be burned by Aaron's sons on the altar, on the burned offering which is on the wood on the fire: it is an offering made by fire of a sweet smell to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 3:6
text: ¶And if what he gives for a peace-offering to the Lord is of the flock, let him give a male or female, without any mark on it.

title: Leviticus 3:7
text: If his offering is a lamb, then let it be placed before the Lord:

title: Leviticus 3:8
text: And he is to put his hand on the head of his offering and put it to death before the Tent of meeting; and Aaron's sons are to put some of its blood on and round the altar.

title: Leviticus 3:9
text: And of the peace-offering, let him give an offering made by fire to the Lord; the fat of it, all the fat tail, he is to take away near the backbone; and the fat covering the inside parts and all the fat on the inside parts,

title: Leviticus 3:10
text: And the two kidneys, with the fat on them, which is by the top part of the legs, and the fat joining the liver and the kidneys, he is to take away;

title: Leviticus 3:11
text: That it may be burned by the priest on the altar; it is the food of the offering made by fire to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 3:12
text: And if his offering is a goat, then let it be placed before the Lord,

title: Leviticus 3:13
text: And let him put his hand on the head of it and put it to death before the Tent of meeting; and the sons of Aaron are to put some of its blood on and round the altar.

title: Leviticus 3:14
text: And of it let him make his offering, an offering made by fire to the Lord; the fat covering the inside parts and all the fat on the inside parts,

title: Leviticus 3:15
text: And the two kidneys, with the fat on them, which is by the top part of the legs, and the fat joining the liver and the kidneys, let him take away;

title: Leviticus 3:16
text: That it may be burned by the priest on the altar; it is the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet smell: all the fat is the Lord's.

title: Leviticus 3:17
text: Let it be an order for ever, through all your generations, in all your houses, that you are not to take fat or blood for food.

title: Leviticus 4:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 4:2
text: Say to the children of Israel: These are the offerings of anyone who does wrong through error, doing any of the things which by the Lord's order are not to be done:

title: Leviticus 4:3
text: If the chief priest by doing wrong becomes a cause of sin to the people, then let him give to the Lord for the sin which he has done, an ox, without any mark, for a sin-offering.

title: Leviticus 4:4
text: And he is to take the ox to the door of the Tent of meeting before the Lord; and put his hand on its head and put it to death before the Lord.

title: Leviticus 4:5
text: And the chief priest is to take some of its blood and take it to the Tent of meeting;

title: Leviticus 4:6
text: And the priest is to put his finger in the blood, shaking drops of it before the Lord seven times, in front of the veil of the holy place.

title: Leviticus 4:7
text: And the priest is to put some of the blood on the horns of the altar on which perfume is burned before the Lord in the Tent of meeting, draining out all the rest of the blood of the ox at the base of the altar of burned offering which is at the door of the Tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 4:8
text: And he is to take away all the fat of the ox of the sin-offering; the fat covering the inside parts and all the fat of the inside parts,

title: Leviticus 4:9
text: And the two kidneys, with the fat on them, which is by the top part of the legs, and the fat joining the liver and the kidneys, he is to take away,

title: Leviticus 4:10
text: As it is taken from the ox of the peace-offering; and it is to be burned by the priest on the altar of burned offerings.

title: Leviticus 4:11
text: And the skin of the ox and all its flesh, with its head and its legs and its inside parts and its waste,

title: Leviticus 4:12
text: All the ox, he is to take away outside the circle of the tents into a clean place where the burned waste is put, and there it is to be burned on wood with fire.

title: Leviticus 4:13
text: ¶And if all the people of Israel do wrong, without anyone's knowledge; if they have done any of the things which by the Lord's order are not to be done, causing sin to come on them;

title: Leviticus 4:14
text: When the sin which they have done comes to light, then let all the people give an ox for a sin-offering, and take it before the Tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 4:15
text: And let the chiefs of the people put their hands on its head before the Lord, and put the ox to death before the Lord.

title: Leviticus 4:16
text: And the priest is to take some of its blood to the Tent of meeting;

title: Leviticus 4:17
text: And put his finger in the blood, shaking drops of the blood seven times before the Lord in front of the veil.

title: Leviticus 4:18
text: And he is to put some of the blood on the horns of the altar which is before the Lord in the Tent of meeting; and all the rest of the blood is to be drained out at the base of the altar of burned offering at the door of the Tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 4:19
text: And he is to take off all its fat, burning it on the altar.

title: Leviticus 4:20
text: Let him do with the ox as he did with the ox of the sin-offering; and the priest will take away their sin and they will have forgiveness.

title: Leviticus 4:21
text: Then let the ox be taken away outside the tent-circle, that it may be burned as the other ox was burned; it is the sin-offering for all the people.

title: Leviticus 4:22
text: ¶If a ruler does wrong, and in error does any of the things which, by the order of the Lord his God, are not to be done, causing sin to come on him;

title: Leviticus 4:23
text: When the sin which he has done is made clear to him, let him give for his offering a goat, a male without any mark.

title: Leviticus 4:24
text: And he is to put his hand on the head of the goat and put it to death in the place where they put to death the burned offering before the Lord: it is a sin-offering.

title: Leviticus 4:25
text: And the priest is to take some of the blood of the offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burned offering, draining out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar of burned offering.

title: Leviticus 4:26
text: And all the fat of it is to be burned on the altar like the fat of the peace-offering; and the priest will take away his sin and he will have forgiveness.

title: Leviticus 4:27
text: ¶And if any one of the common people does wrong in error, doing any of the things which the Lord has given orders are not to be done, causing sin to come on him;

title: Leviticus 4:28
text: When the sin which he has done is made clear to him, then he is to give for his offering a goat, a female without any mark, for the sin which he has done.

title: Leviticus 4:29
text: And he is to put his hand on the head of the sin-offering and put it to death in the place where they put to death the burned offering.

title: Leviticus 4:30
text: And the priest is to take some of the blood with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burned offering, and all the rest of its blood is to be drained out at the base of the altar.

title: Leviticus 4:31
text: And let all its fat be taken away, as the fat is taken away from the peace-offerings, and let it be burned on the altar by the priest for a sweet smell to the Lord; and the priest will take away his sin and he will have forgiveness.

title: Leviticus 4:32
text: And if he gives a lamb as his sin-offering, let it be a female without any mark;

title: Leviticus 4:33
text: And he is to put his hand on the head of the offering and put it to death for a sin-offering in the place where they put to death the burned offering.

title: Leviticus 4:34
text: And the priest is to take some of the blood of the offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burned offering, and all the rest of the blood is to be drained out at the base of the altar;

title: Leviticus 4:35
text: And let him take away all its fat, as the fat is taken away from the lamb of the peace-offerings; and let it be burned by the priest on the altar among the offerings made by fire to the Lord: and the priest will take away his sin and he will have forgiveness.

title: Leviticus 5:1
text: ¶And if anyone does wrong by saying nothing when he is put under oath as a witness of something he has seen or had knowledge of, then he will be responsible:

title: Leviticus 5:2
text: If anyone becomes unclean through touching unconsciously some unclean thing, such as the dead body of an unclean beast or of unclean cattle or of any unclean animal which goes flat on the earth, he will be responsible:

title: Leviticus 5:3
text: Or if he becomes unclean through touching unconsciously any unclean thing of man, whatever it may be, when it is made clear to him he will be responsible:

title: Leviticus 5:4
text: Or if anyone, without thought, takes an oath to do evil or to do good, whatever he says without thought, with an oath, having no knowledge of what he is doing; when it becomes clear to him, he will be responsible for any of these things.

title: Leviticus 5:5
text: And whoever is responsible for any such sin, let him make a statement openly of his wrongdoing;

title: Leviticus 5:6
text: And take to the Lord the offering for the wrong which he has done, a female from the flock, a lamb or a goat, for a sin-offering, and the priest will take away his sin.

title: Leviticus 5:7
text: ¶And if he has not money enough for a lamb, then let him give, for his offering to the Lord, two doves or two young pigeons; one for a sin-offering and one for a burned offering.

title: Leviticus 5:8
text: And let him take them to the priest, who will first give the sin-offering, twisting off its head from its neck, but not cutting it in two;

title: Leviticus 5:9
text: And he is to put drops of the blood of the offering on the side of the altar, and the rest of the blood is to be drained out at the base of the altar; it is a sin-offering.

title: Leviticus 5:10
text: And the second is for a burned offering, in agreement with the law; and the priest will take away his sin and he will have forgiveness.

title: Leviticus 5:11
text: But if he has not enough money for two doves or two young pigeons, then let him give, for the sin he has done, the tenth part of an ephah of the best meal, for a sin-offering; let him put no oil on it, and no perfume, for it is a sin-offering.

title: Leviticus 5:12
text: And let him come to the priest with it, and the priest will take some of it in his hand, to be burned on the altar as a sign, among the offerings of the Lord made by fire: it is a sin-offering.

title: Leviticus 5:13
text: And the priest will take away his sin and he will have forgiveness: and the rest of the offering will be the priest's, in the same way as the meal offering.

title: Leviticus 5:14
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 5:15
text: If anyone is untrue, sinning in error in connection with the holy things of the Lord, let him take his offering to the Lord, a male sheep from the flock, without any mark, of the value fixed by you in silver by shekels, by the scale of the holy place.

title: Leviticus 5:16
text: And he is to make payment to the priest for what he has done wrong in relation to the holy thing, together with a fifth part of its value in addition; and the priest will take away his sin by the sheep of his offering, and he will have forgiveness.

title: Leviticus 5:17
text: And if anyone does wrong, and does any of the things which the Lord has given orders are not to be done, though he has no knowledge of it, still he is in the wrong and he is responsible.

title: Leviticus 5:18
text: Let him come to the priest with a sheep, a male without any mark out of the flock, of the value fixed by you, as an offering for his error; and the priest will take away the sin which he did in error, and he will have forgiveness.

title: Leviticus 5:19
text: It is an offering for his error: he is certainly responsible before the Lord.

title: Leviticus 6:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 6:2
text: If anyone does wrong, and is untrue to the Lord, acting falsely to his neighbour in connection with something put in his care, or something given for a debt, or has taken away anything by force, or has been cruel to his neighbour,

title: Leviticus 6:3
text: Or has taken a false oath about the loss of something which he has come across by chance; if a man has done any of these evil things,

title: Leviticus 6:4
text: Causing sin to come on him, then he will have to give back the thing he took by force or got by cruel acts, or the goods which were put in his care or the thing he came on by chance,

title: Leviticus 6:5
text: Or anything about which he took a false oath; he will have to give it all back, with the addition of a fifth of its value, to him whose property it is, when he has been judged to be in the wrong.

title: Leviticus 6:6
text: Then let him take to the Lord the offering for his wrongdoing; giving to the priest for his offering, a male sheep from the flock, without any mark, of the value fixed by you:

title: Leviticus 6:7
text: And the priest will take away his sin from before the Lord, and he will have forgiveness for whatever crime he has done

title: Leviticus 6:8
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 6:9
text: Give orders to Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law for the burned offering: the offering is to be on the fire-wood on the altar all night till the morning; and the fire of the altar is to be kept burning.

title: Leviticus 6:10
text: And the priest is to put on his linen robes and his linen trousers, and take up what is over of the offering after it has been burned on the altar, and put it by the side of the altar.

title: Leviticus 6:11
text: Then having taken off his linen robes and put on other clothing, he is to take it away into a clean place, outside the tent-circle.

title: Leviticus 6:12
text: The fire on the altar is to be kept burning; it is never to go out; every morning the priest is to put wood on it, placing the burned offering in order on it, and there the fat of the peace-offering is to be burned.

title: Leviticus 6:13
text: Let the fire be kept burning on the altar at all times; it is never to go out.

title: Leviticus 6:14
text: ¶And this is the law for the meal offering: it is to be offered to the Lord before the altar by the sons of Aaron.

title: Leviticus 6:15
text: The priest is to take in his hand some of the meal of the meal offering and of the oil of it, and all the perfume on it, burning it on the altar as a sign, for a sweet smell to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 6:16
text: And whatever is over Aaron and his sons may have for their food, taking it without leaven in a holy place; in the open space of the Tent of meeting they may take a meal of it.

title: Leviticus 6:17
text: It is not to be cooked with leaven. I have given it to them as their part of the offerings made by fire to me; it is most holy, as are the sin-offerings and the offerings for error.

title: Leviticus 6:18
text: Every male among the children of Aaron may have it for food; it is their right for ever through all your generations, from the offerings made by fire to the Lord: anyone touching them will be holy.

title: Leviticus 6:19
text: And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 6:20
text: This is the offering which Aaron and his sons are to make to the Lord on the day when he is made a priest: the tenth part of an ephah of the best meal for a meal offering for ever; half of it in the morning and half in the evening.

title: Leviticus 6:21
text: Let it be made with oil on a flat plate; when it is well mixed and cooked, let it be broken and taken in as a meal offering, for a sweet smell to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 6:22
text: And the same offering is to be given by that one of his sons who takes his place as priest; by an order for ever, all of it is to be burned before the Lord.

title: Leviticus 6:23
text: Every meal offering offered for the priest is to be completely burned: nothing of it is to be taken for food.

title: Leviticus 6:24
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 6:25
text: Say to Aaron and his sons, This is the law for the sin-offering: the sin-offering is to be put to death before the Lord in the same place as the burned offering; it is most holy.

title: Leviticus 6:26
text: The priest by whom it is offered for sin, is to take it for his food in a holy place, in the open space of the Tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 6:27
text: Anyone touching the flesh of it will be holy: and if any of the blood is dropped on any clothing, the thing on which the blood has been dropped is to be washed in a holy place.

title: Leviticus 6:28
text: But the vessel of earth in which the flesh was cooked is to be broken; or if a brass vessel was used, it is to be rubbed clean and washed out with water.

title: Leviticus 6:29
text: Every male among the priests may take it for his food: it is most holy.

title: Leviticus 6:30
text: No sin-offering, the blood of which is taken into the Tent of meeting, to take away sin in the holy place, may be used for food: it is to be burned with fire.

title: Leviticus 7:1
text: ¶And this is the law of the offering for wrongdoing: it is most holy.

title: Leviticus 7:2
text: They are to put to death the offering for wrongdoing in the same place as the burned offering; and the priest is to put the blood on and round the altar.

title: Leviticus 7:3
text: And all the fat of it, the fat tail and the fat covering the inside parts, is to be given as an offering.

title: Leviticus 7:4
text: And the two kidneys, and the fat on them, which is by the top of the legs, and the fat joining the liver and the kidneys, he is to take away:

title: Leviticus 7:5
text: They are to be burned by the priest on the altar for an offering made by fire to the Lord: it is an offering for wrongdoing.

title: Leviticus 7:6
text: Every male among the priests may have it as food in a holy place: it is most holy.

title: Leviticus 7:7
text: As is the sin-offering, so is the offering for wrongdoing; there is one law for them: the priest who makes the offering to take away sin, he is to have it.

title: Leviticus 7:8
text: And the priest offering any man's burned offering for him, may have the skin of the burned offering which is offered by him.

title: Leviticus 7:9
text: And every meal offering which is cooked in the oven and everything made in a cooking pot or on a flat plate, is for the priest by whom it is offered.

title: Leviticus 7:10
text: And every meal offering, mixed with oil or dry, is for all the sons of Aaron in equal measure.

title: Leviticus 7:11
text: ¶And this is the law for the peace-offerings offered to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 7:12
text: If any man gives his offering as a praise-offering, then let him give with the offering, unleavened cakes mixed with oil and thin unleavened cakes covered with oil and cakes of the best meal well mixed with oil.

title: Leviticus 7:13
text: With his peace-offering let him give cakes of leavened bread, as a praise-offering.

title: Leviticus 7:14
text: And let him give one out of every offering to be lifted up before the Lord; that it may be for the priest who puts the blood of the peace-offering on the altar.

title: Leviticus 7:15
text: And the flesh of the praise-offering is to be taken as food on the day when it is offered; no part of it may be kept till the morning.

title: Leviticus 7:16
text: But if his offering is made because of an oath or given freely, it may be taken as food on the day when it is offered; and the rest may be used up on the day after:

title: Leviticus 7:17
text: But if any of the flesh of the offering is still unused on the third day, it is to be burned with fire.

title: Leviticus 7:18
text: And if any of the flesh of the peace-offering is taken as food on the third day, it will not be pleasing to God and will not be put to the account of him who gives it; it will be unclean and a cause of sin to him who takes it as food.

title: Leviticus 7:19
text: And flesh touched by any unclean thing may not be taken for food: it is to be burned with fire; and as for the flesh of the peace-offerings, everyone who is clean may take it as food:

title: Leviticus 7:20
text: But he who is unclean when he takes as food the flesh of the peace-offerings, which are the Lord's, will be cut off from his people.

title: Leviticus 7:21
text: And anyone who, after touching any unclean thing of man or an unclean beast or any unclean and disgusting thing, takes as food the flesh of the peace-offerings, which are the Lord's, will be cut off from his people.

title: Leviticus 7:22
text: And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 7:23
text: Say to the children of Israel: You are not to take any fat, of ox or sheep or goat, for food.

title: Leviticus 7:24
text: And the fat of that which comes to a natural death, and the fat of that which is attacked by beasts, may be used for other purposes, but not in any way for food.

title: Leviticus 7:25
text: For anyone who takes as food the fat of any beast of which men make an offering by fire to the Lord, will be cut off from his people.

title: Leviticus 7:26
text: And you are not to take for food any blood, of bird or of beast, in any of your houses.

title: Leviticus 7:27
text: Whoever takes any blood for food will be cut off from his people.

title: Leviticus 7:28
text: And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 7:29
text: Say to the children of Israel: He who makes a peace-offering to the Lord, is to give an offering to the Lord out of his peace-offering:

title: Leviticus 7:30
text: He himself is to take to the Lord the offering made by fire, even the fat with the breast, so that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the Lord.

title: Leviticus 7:31
text: And the fat is to be burned by the priest on the altar, but the breast is for Aaron and his sons.

title: Leviticus 7:32
text: And the right leg you are to give to the priest for an offering to be lifted up out of what is given for your peace-offerings.

title: Leviticus 7:33
text: That man, among the sons of Aaron, by whom the blood of the peace-offering and the fat are offered, is to have the right leg for his part.

title: Leviticus 7:34
text: For the breast which is waved and the right leg which is lifted up on high I have taken from the children of Israel, from their peace-offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as their right for ever from the children of Israel.

title: Leviticus 7:35
text: ¶This is the holy part given to Aaron and to his sons, out of the offerings made to the Lord by fire, on the day when they were made priests before the Lord;

title: Leviticus 7:36
text: Which the Lord said the children of Israel were to give them, on the day when he made them his priests. It is their right for ever from generation to generation.

title: Leviticus 7:37
text: These are the laws for the burned offering, the meal offering, and the offering for wrongdoing; and for the making of priests, and for the giving of peace-offerings;

title: Leviticus 7:38
text: As they were given by the Lord to Moses on Mount Sinai, on the day when the Lord gave orders to the children of Israel to make their offerings to the Lord, in the waste land of Sinai.

title: Leviticus 8:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 8:2
text: Take Aaron, and his sons with him, and the robes and the holy oil and the ox of the sin-offering and the two male sheep and the basket of unleavened bread;

title: Leviticus 8:3
text: And let all the people come together at the door of the Tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 8:4
text: And Moses did as the Lord said, and all the people came together at the door of the Tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 8:5
text: And Moses said to the people, This is what the Lord has given orders to be done.

title: Leviticus 8:6
text: Then Moses took Aaron and his sons; and after washing them with water,

title: Leviticus 8:7
text: He put the coat on him, making it tight with its band, and then the robe, and over it the ephod, with its band of needlework to keep it in place.

title: Leviticus 8:8
text: And he put the priest's bag on him, and in the bag he put the Urim and Thummim.

title: Leviticus 8:9
text: And on his head he put the head-dress, and in front of the head-dress the plate of gold, the holy crown, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

title: Leviticus 8:10
text: And Moses took the holy oil and put it on the House and on all the things in it, to make them holy.

title: Leviticus 8:11
text: Seven times he put oil on the altar and on all its vessels, and on the washing-basin and its base, to make them holy.

title: Leviticus 8:12
text: And some of the oil he put on Aaron's head, to make him holy.

title: Leviticus 8:13
text: Then he took Aaron's sons, clothing them with the coats, and putting the bands round them, and the head-dresses on their heads, as the Lord had given him orders.

title: Leviticus 8:14
text: ¶And he took the ox of the sin-offering: and Aaron and his sons put their hands on the head of the ox,

title: Leviticus 8:15
text: And he put it to death; and Moses took the blood and put it on the horns of the altar and round it with his finger, and made the altar clean, draining out the blood at the base of the altar; so he made it holy, taking away what was unclean.

title: Leviticus 8:16
text: And he took all the fat on the inside parts, and the fat on the liver, and the two kidneys with their fat, to be burned on the altar;

title: Leviticus 8:17
text: But the ox, with its skin and its flesh and its waste, was burned with fire outside the tent-circle, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

title: Leviticus 8:18
text: And he put the male sheep of the burned offering before the Lord, and Aaron and his sons put their hands on its head,

title: Leviticus 8:19
text: And he put it to death; and Moses put some of the blood on and round the altar.

title: Leviticus 8:20
text: And when the sheep had been cut into parts, the head and the parts and the fat were burned by Moses.

title: Leviticus 8:21
text: And the inside parts and the legs were washed with water and all the sheep was burned by Moses on the altar; it was a burned offering for a sweet smell: it was an offering made by fire to the Lord, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

title: Leviticus 8:22
text: And he put the other sheep before the Lord, the sheep with which they were made priests; and Aaron and his sons put their hands on the head of the sheep,

title: Leviticus 8:23
text: And he put it to death; and Moses took some of the blood and put it on the point of Aaron's right ear and on the thumb of his right hand and on the great toe of his right foot.

title: Leviticus 8:24
text: Then he took Aaron's sons, and Moses put some of the blood on the point of their right ears and on the thumbs of their right hands and on the great toes of their right feet: and Moses put the blood on and round the altar.

title: Leviticus 8:25
text: And he took the fat, and the fat tail, and the fat on the inside parts, and the fat on the liver, and the two kidneys with their fat, and the right leg;

title: Leviticus 8:26
text: And out of the basket of unleavened bread which was before the Lord he took one unleavened cake, and one cake of bread with oil on it, and one thin cake, and put them on the fat and on the right leg:

title: Leviticus 8:27
text: And he put them all on the hands of Aaron and on the hands of his sons, waving them for a wave offering before the Lord.

title: Leviticus 8:28
text: And Moses took them from their hands, and they were burned on the altar on the burned offering, as a priest's offering for a sweet smell, an offering made by fire to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 8:29
text: And Moses took the breast, waving it for a wave offering before the Lord; it was Moses' part of the sheep of the priest's offering, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

title: Leviticus 8:30
text: And Moses took some of the holy oil and of the blood which was on the altar and put it on Aaron and on his robes, and on his sons and on his sons' robes; and made Aaron holy, and his robes and his sons and his sons' robes with him.

title: Leviticus 8:31
text: ¶And Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, The flesh is to be cooked in water at the door of the Tent of meeting, and there you are to take it as food, together with the bread in the basket, as I have given orders, saying, It is the food of Aaron and his sons.

title: Leviticus 8:32
text: And that which is over of the flesh and of the bread is to be burned with fire.

title: Leviticus 8:33
text: And you are not to go out from the door of the Tent of meeting for seven days, till the days for making you priest are ended; for this will be the work of seven days.

title: Leviticus 8:34
text: What has been done this day, has been ordered by the Lord to take away your sin.

title: Leviticus 8:35
text: And you are to keep watch for the Lord at the door of the Tent of meeting day and night for seven days, so that death may not come to you: for so he has given me orders.

title: Leviticus 8:36
text: And Aaron and his sons did all the things about which the Lord had given orders through Moses.

title: Leviticus 9:1
text: ¶And on the eighth day Moses sent for Aaron and his sons and the responsible men of Israel;

title: Leviticus 9:2
text: And he said to Aaron, Take a young ox for a sin-offering and a male sheep for a burned offering, without a mark, and make an offering of them before the Lord.

title: Leviticus 9:3
text: And say to the children of Israel: Take a he-goat for a sin-offering, and a young ox and a lamb, in their first year, without any mark on them, for a burned offering;

title: Leviticus 9:4
text: And an ox and a male sheep for peace-offerings, to be put to death before the Lord; and a meal offering mixed with oil: for this day you are to see the Lord.

title: Leviticus 9:5
text: And they took the things ordered by Moses, before the Tent of meeting, and all the people came near, waiting before the Lord.

title: Leviticus 9:6
text: And Moses said, This is what the Lord has said you are to do; and you will see the glory of the Lord.

title: Leviticus 9:7
text: And Moses said to Aaron, Come near to the altar and make your sin-offering and your burned offering to take away your sin and the sin of the people, and make the people's offering to take away their sin; as the Lord has given orders.

title: Leviticus 9:8
text: ¶So Aaron came near to the altar and put to death the ox for the sin-offering for himself;

title: Leviticus 9:9
text: And the sons of Aaron gave him the blood and he put his finger in the blood and put it on the horns of the altar, draining out the blood at the base of the altar;

title: Leviticus 9:10
text: But the fat and the kidneys and the fat on the liver of the sin-offering were burned by him on the altar as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

title: Leviticus 9:11
text: And the flesh and the skin were burned with fire outside the tent-circle;

title: Leviticus 9:12
text: And he put to death the burned offering; and Aaron's sons gave him the blood and he put some of it on and round the altar;

title: Leviticus 9:13
text: And they gave him the parts of the burned offering, in their order, and the head, to be burned on the altar.

title: Leviticus 9:14
text: And the inside parts and the legs, when they had been washed with water, were burned on the burned offering on the altar.

title: Leviticus 9:15
text: And he made an offering for the people and took the goat of the sin-offering for the people and put it to death, offering it for sin, in the same way as the first.

title: Leviticus 9:16
text: And he took the burned offering, offering it in the ordered way;

title: Leviticus 9:17
text: And he put the meal offering before the Lord, and taking some of it in his hand he had it burned on the altar, separately from the burned offering of the morning.

title: Leviticus 9:18
text: And he put to death the ox and the sheep, which were the peace-offerings for the people; and Aaron's sons gave him the blood and he put some of it on and round the altar;

title: Leviticus 9:19
text: And as for the fat of the ox and the fat tail of the sheep and the fat covering the inside parts and the kidneys and the fat on the liver;

title: Leviticus 9:20
text: They put the fat on the breasts, and the fat was burned on the altar.

title: Leviticus 9:21
text: And Aaron took the breasts and the right leg, waving them for a wave offering before the Lord, as Moses gave orders.

title: Leviticus 9:22
text: And Aaron, lifting up his hands to the people, gave them a blessing; and he came down from offering the sin-offering, and the burned offering, and the peace-offerings.

title: Leviticus 9:23
text: ¶And Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of meeting, and came out and gave the people a blessing, and the glory of the Lord was seen by all the people.

title: Leviticus 9:24
text: And fire came out from before the Lord, burning up the offering on the altar and the fat: and when all the people saw it, they gave a loud cry, falling down on their faces.

title: Leviticus 10:1
text: ¶And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took their vessels and put fire in them and perfume, burning strange fire before the Lord, which he had not given them orders to do.

title: Leviticus 10:2
text: And fire came out from before the Lord, burning them up and causing their destruction before the Lord.

title: Leviticus 10:3
text: ¶Then Moses said to Aaron, This is what the Lord said, I will be holy in the eyes of all those who come near to me, and I will be honoured before all the people. And Aaron said nothing.

title: Leviticus 10:4
text: And Moses sent for Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel, the brother of Aaron's father, and said to them, Come near and take your brothers away from before the holy place, outside the tent-circle.

title: Leviticus 10:5
text: So they came and took them, in their coats, outside the tent-circle, as Moses had said.

title: Leviticus 10:6
text: And Moses said to Aaron and to Eleazar and Ithamar, his sons, Do not let your hair be loose, and give no signs of grief; so that death may not overtake you, and his wrath come on all the people; but let there be weeping among your brothers and all the house of Israel for this burning of the Lord's fire.

title: Leviticus 10:7
text: And do not go out from the door of the Tent of meeting, or death will come to you; for the holy oil of the Lord is on you. And they did as Moses said.

title: Leviticus 10:8
text: ¶And the Lord said to Aaron:

title: Leviticus 10:9
text: Take no wine, or strong drink, you or your sons with you, when you go into the Tent of meeting, that it may not be the cause of death to you; this is an order for ever through all your generations.

title: Leviticus 10:10
text: And make a division between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean;

title: Leviticus 10:11
text: Teaching the children of Israel all the laws which the Lord has given them by the hand of Moses.

title: Leviticus 10:12
text: ¶And Moses said to Aaron and to Eleazar and Ithamar, his sons who were still living, Take the rest of the meal offering from the offerings of the Lord made by fire, and take it for your food, without leaven, at the side of the altar, for it is most holy.

title: Leviticus 10:13
text: It is to be for your food in a holy place, because it is your right and your sons' right, from the offerings of the Lord made by fire: for so am I ordered.

title: Leviticus 10:14
text: And the breast which is waved and the leg which is lifted up on high, you are to take as your food in a clean place; you and your sons and your daughters with you: for they are given to you as your right and your sons' right, from the peace-offerings of the children of Israel.

title: Leviticus 10:15
text: Let them take the breast which is waved and the leg which is lifted up on high, with the fat of the burned offering, to be waved for a wave offering before the Lord; and this will be for you and for your sons with you, for a right for ever, as the Lord has given orders.

title: Leviticus 10:16
text: And Moses was looking for the goat of the sin-offering, but it was burned; and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron, who were still living, saying,

title: Leviticus 10:17
text: Why did you not make a meal of the sin-offering in the holy place? For it is most holy and he has given it to you, so that the sin of the people may be put on it, to take away their sin before the Lord.

title: Leviticus 10:18
text: See, its blood was not taken into the holy place: certainly it was right for you to have taken it as food in the holy place, as I gave orders.

title: Leviticus 10:19
text: And Aaron said to Moses, You have seen that today they have made their sin-offering and their burned offering before the Lord, and such things as these have come on me. If I had taken the sin-offering as food today, would it have been pleasing to the Lord?

title: Leviticus 10:20
text: And after hearing this, Moses was no longer angry.

title: Leviticus 11:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

title: Leviticus 11:2
text: Say to the children of Israel: These are the living things which you may have for food among all the beasts on the earth.

title: Leviticus 11:3
text: You may have as food any beast which has a division in the horn of its foot, and whose food comes back into its mouth to be crushed again.

title: Leviticus 11:4
text: But, at the same time, of those beasts, you may not take for food the camel, because its food comes back but the horn of its foot is not parted in two; it is unclean to you.

title: Leviticus 11:5
text: And the rock-badger, for the same reason, is unclean to you.

title: Leviticus 11:6
text: And the hare, because the horn of its foot is not parted in two, is unclean to you.

title: Leviticus 11:7
text: And the pig is unclean to you, because though the horn of its foot is parted, its food does not come back.

title: Leviticus 11:8
text: Their flesh may not be used for food, and their dead bodies may not even be touched; they are unclean to you.

title: Leviticus 11:9
text: ¶These you may have for food of all things living in the water: anything living in the water, in the seas or rivers, which has special parts for swimming and skin formed of thin plates, may be used for food.

title: Leviticus 11:10
text: All other things living and moving in the water, in the sea or in the rivers, are a disgusting thing to you;

title: Leviticus 11:11
text: They may not be used for food, and their dead bodies are disgusting to you.

title: Leviticus 11:12
text: Anything in the water which has no special parts for swimming and no thin plates on its skin is disgusting to you.

title: Leviticus 11:13
text: And among birds these are to be disgusting to you, and not to be used for food: the eagle and the gier-eagle and the ospray;

title: Leviticus 11:14
text: And the kite and the falcon, and birds of that sort;

title: Leviticus 11:15
text: Every raven, and birds of that sort;

title: Leviticus 11:16
text: And the ostrich and the night-hawk and the sea-hawk, and birds of that sort;

title: Leviticus 11:17
text: And the little owl and the cormorant and the great owl;

title: Leviticus 11:18
text: And the water-hen and the pelican and the vulture;

title: Leviticus 11:19
text: The stork and the heron, and birds of that sort, and the hoopoe and the bat.

title: Leviticus 11:20
text: ¶Every winged four-footed thing which goes on the earth is disgusting to you;

title: Leviticus 11:21
text: But of the winged four-footed things, those which have long legs for jumping on the earth you may have for food;

title: Leviticus 11:22
text: Such as all the different sorts of locust.

title: Leviticus 11:23
text: But all other winged four-footed things which go on the earth are disgusting to you.

title: Leviticus 11:24
text: By these you will be made unclean; anyone touching their dead bodies will be unclean till evening:

title: Leviticus 11:25
text: Whoever takes away the dead body of one of them is to have his clothing washed, and will be unclean till evening.

title: Leviticus 11:26
text: Every beast, in the horn of whose foot there is not a complete division, and whose food does not come back, is unclean to you: anyone touching one of these will be unclean.

title: Leviticus 11:27
text: Any four-footed beast which goes on the ball of its foot, is unclean to you: anyone touching the dead body of one of these will be unclean till evening.

title: Leviticus 11:28
text: Anyone who takes away the dead body of one of these is to have his clothing washed and be unclean till evening.

title: Leviticus 11:29
text: And these are unclean to you among things which go low down on the earth; the weasel and the mouse and the great lizard, and animals of that sort;

title: Leviticus 11:30
text: And the ferret and the land crocodile and the lizard and the sand-lizard and the chameleon.

title: Leviticus 11:31
text: All these are unclean to you: anyone touching them when they are dead will be unclean till evening.

title: Leviticus 11:32
text: The dead body of any of these, falling on anything, will make that thing unclean; if it is any vessel of wood, or clothing, or skin, or bag, whatever it is, if it is used for any purpose, it will have to be put into water, and will be unclean till evening; after that it will be clean.

title: Leviticus 11:33
text: And if one of them gets into any vessel of earth, whatever is in the vessel will be unclean and the vessel will have to be broken.

title: Leviticus 11:34
text: Any food in it, and anything on which water from it comes, will be unclean: any drink taken from such a vessel will be unclean.

title: Leviticus 11:35
text: Any part of the dead body of one of these, falling on anything, will make it unclean; if it is an oven or a cooking-pot it will have to be broken: they are unclean and will be unclean to you.

title: Leviticus 11:36
text: But at the same time a fountain or a place where water is stored for use will be clean; but anyone touching their dead bodies will be unclean.

title: Leviticus 11:37
text: If any part of the dead body of one of these gets on to any seed for planting, it is clean;

title: Leviticus 11:38
text: But if water is put on the seed, and any part of the dead body gets on to it, it will be unclean to you.

title: Leviticus 11:39
text: And if any beast which may be used for food comes to a natural death, anyone touching its dead body will be unclean till evening.

title: Leviticus 11:40
text: And he who makes use of any part of its body for food is to have his clothing washed and be unclean till evening; and anyone taking away its body is to have his clothing washed and be unclean till evening.

title: Leviticus 11:41
text: Everything which goes flat on its body on the earth is disgusting, and is not to be used for food.

title: Leviticus 11:42
text: Whatever goes on its stomach or on four feet or has a great number of feet, even all those going flat on the earth, may not be used for food, for they are disgusting.

title: Leviticus 11:43
text: ¶You are not to make yourselves disgusting with anything which goes about flat on the earth; you may not make yourselves unclean with them, in such a way that you are not holy to me.

title: Leviticus 11:44
text: For I am the Lord your God: for this reason, make and keep yourselves holy, for I am holy; you are not to make yourselves unclean with any sort of thing which goes about flat on the earth.

title: Leviticus 11:45
text: For I am the Lord, who took you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God; so be you holy, for I am holy.

title: Leviticus 11:46
text: This is the law about beasts and birds and every living thing moving in the waters, and every living thing which goes flat on the earth:

title: Leviticus 11:47
text: Marking out the unclean from the clean, and the living thing which may be used for food from that which may not.

title: Leviticus 12:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 12:2
text: Say to the children of Israel, If a woman is with child and gives birth to a male child, she will be unclean for seven days, as when she is unwell.

title: Leviticus 12:3
text: And on the eighth day let him be given circumcision.

title: Leviticus 12:4
text: And she will be unclean for thirty-three days till the flow of her blood is stopped; no holy thing may be touched by her, and she may not come into the holy place, till the days for making her clean are ended.

title: Leviticus 12:5
text: But if she gives birth to a female child, then she will be unclean for two weeks, as when she is unwell; and she will not be completely clean for sixty-six days.

title: Leviticus 12:6
text: ¶And when the days are ended for making her clean for a son or a daughter, let her take to the priest at the door of the Tent of meeting, a lamb of the first year for a burned offering and a young pigeon or a dove for a sin-offering:

title: Leviticus 12:7
text: And the priest is to make an offering of it before the Lord and take away her sin, and she will be made clean from the flow of her blood. This is the law for a woman who gives birth to a male or a female.

title: Leviticus 12:8
text: And if she has not money enough for a lamb, then let her take two doves or two young pigeons, one for a burned offering and the other for a sin-offering, and the priest will take away her sin and she will be clean,

title: Leviticus 13:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

title: Leviticus 13:2
text: If a man has on his skin a growth or a mark or a white place, and it becomes the disease of a leper, let him be taken to Aaron the priest, or to one of the priests, his sons;

title: Leviticus 13:3
text: And if, when the priest sees the mark on his skin, the hair on the place is turned white and the mark seems to go deeper than the skin, it is the mark of a leper: and the priest, after looking at him, will say that he is unclean.

title: Leviticus 13:4
text: But if the mark on his skin is white, and does not seem to go deeper than the skin, and the hair on it is not turned white, then the priest will keep him shut up for seven days;

title: Leviticus 13:5
text: And the priest is to see him on the seventh day; and if, in his opinion, the place on his skin has not become worse and is not increased in size, then the priest will keep him shut up for seven days more:

title: Leviticus 13:6
text: And the priest is to see him again on the seventh day; and if the mark is less bright and is not increased on his skin, then let the priest say that he is clean: it is only a skin-mark, and after his clothing has been washed he will be clean.

title: Leviticus 13:7
text: But if the size of the mark on his skin is increased after he has been seen by the priest, let him go to the priest again:

title: Leviticus 13:8
text: And if, after looking at him, he sees that the mark is increased in his skin, let the priest say that he is unclean; he is a leper.

title: Leviticus 13:9
text: When the disease of a leper is seen on a man, let him be taken to the priest;

title: Leviticus 13:10
text: And if the priest sees that there is a white growth on the skin, and the hair is turned white, and there is diseased flesh in the growth,

title: Leviticus 13:11
text: It is an old disease in the skin of his flesh, and the priest will say that he is unclean; he will not have to be shut up, for he is clearly unclean.

title: Leviticus 13:12
text: And if the disease comes out all over his skin, from his head to his feet, as far as the priest is able to see,

title: Leviticus 13:13
text: And if the priest sees that all his flesh is covered with the leper's disease, the priest will say that he is clean: it is all turned white, he is clean.

title: Leviticus 13:14
text: But whenever diseased flesh is seen on him, he will be unclean.

title: Leviticus 13:15
text: And when the priest sees the diseased flesh he will say that he is unclean; the diseased flesh is unclean, he is a leper.

title: Leviticus 13:16
text: Or if the diseased flesh is turned again and changed to white then he is to come to the priest,

title: Leviticus 13:17
text: And the priest will see him: and if the place is turned white, then the priest will say that he is free from the disease.

title: Leviticus 13:18
text: ¶And if a bad place has come out on the skin and is well again,

title: Leviticus 13:19
text: And on the same place there is a white growth of a bright mark, red and white, then let the priest see it;

title: Leviticus 13:20
text: And after looking at it, if it seems to go deeper than the skin, and the hair on it is turned white, then the priest will say that the man is unclean: it is the leper's disease, it has come out in the bad place.

title: Leviticus 13:21
text: But if, after looking at it, he sees that there are no white hairs on it, and it is not deeper than the skin, and it is not very bright, then let the priest keep him shut up for seven days:

title: Leviticus 13:22
text: And if it is increasing on the skin, the priest will say that he is unclean: it is a disease.

title: Leviticus 13:23
text: But if the bright mark keeps in the same place and gets no greater, it is the mark of the old wound, and the priest will say that he is clean.

title: Leviticus 13:24
text: Or if there is a burn on the skin of the flesh, and if the diseased flesh in the burn becomes a bright place, red and white or white,

title: Leviticus 13:25
text: The priest is to see it: and if the hair on the bright place is turned white and it seems to go deeper than the skin, he is a leper: it has come out in the burn, and the priest will say that he is unclean: it is the leper's disease.

title: Leviticus 13:26
text: But if, after looking at it, the priest sees that there is no white hair on the bright place, and it is not deeper than the skin, and is not very bright, then let the priest keep him shut up for seven days:

title: Leviticus 13:27
