text: And the priest is to see him again on the seventh day; if it is increased in the skin, then the priest will say that he is unclean: it is the leper's disease.

title: Leviticus 13:28
text: And if the bright place keeps the same size and gets no greater on the skin, but is less bright, it is the effect of the burn, and the priest will say that he is clean: it is the mark of the burn.

title: Leviticus 13:29
text: And when a man or a woman has a disease on the head, or in the hair of the chin,

title: Leviticus 13:30
text: Then the priest is to see the diseased place: and if it seems to go deeper than the skin, and if there is thin yellow hair in it, then the priest will say that he is unclean: he has the mark of the leper's disease on his head or in the hair of his chin.

title: Leviticus 13:31
text: And after looking at the diseased place, if it does not seem to go deeper than the skin, and there is no black hair in it, then the priest will have him shut up for seven days:

title: Leviticus 13:32
text: And on the seventh day the priest will see the place: and if it is not increased, and there is no yellow hair in it, and it does not seem to go deeper than the skin,

title: Leviticus 13:33
text: Then his hair is to be cut off, but not on the diseased place, and he is to be shut up for seven days more:

title: Leviticus 13:34
text: And on the seventh day the priest will see the place: and if it is not increased, and does not seem to go deeper than the skin, the priest will say that he is clean: and after his clothing has been washed he will be clean.

title: Leviticus 13:35
text: But if the disease in his skin becomes worse after he has been made clean,

title: Leviticus 13:36
text: Then the priest is to see him: and if the mark is increased, the priest, without looking for the yellow hair, will say that he is unclean.

title: Leviticus 13:37
text: But if, in his opinion, the growth is stopped, and black hair has come up on it, the disease has gone; he is clean and the priest will say that he is clean.

title: Leviticus 13:38
text: ¶And if a man or a woman has bright marks on the skin of their flesh, that is, bright white marks,

title: Leviticus 13:39
text: Then the priest is to see them: and if the white marks on their skin are not very bright, it is a skin disease which has come out on the skin; he is clean.

title: Leviticus 13:40
text: And if a man's hair has come out and he has no hair, still he is clean.

title: Leviticus 13:41
text: And if the hair has gone from the front part of his head, so that he has no hair there, still he is clean.

title: Leviticus 13:42
text: But if, on his head or on his brow, where he has no hair, there is a red and white place, it is the disease of the leper coming out on his head or on his brow.

title: Leviticus 13:43
text: Then if the priest sees that the growth of the disease has become red and white on his head or on his brow where there is no hair, like the mark in the skin of a leper;

title: Leviticus 13:44
text: He is a leper and unclean; the priest is to say that he is most certainly unclean: the disease is in his head.

title: Leviticus 13:45
text: And the leper who has the disease on him is to go about with signs of grief, with his hair loose and his mouth covered, crying, Unclean, unclean.

title: Leviticus 13:46
text: While the disease is on him, he will be unclean. He is unclean: let him keep by himself, living outside the tent-circle.

title: Leviticus 13:47
text: ¶And any clothing of wool or of linen in which is the mark of the disease;

title: Leviticus 13:48
text: If it is in the threads of the linen or of the wool, or in leather, or in anything made of skin;

title: Leviticus 13:49
text: If there are red or green marks on the clothing, or on the leather, or in the threads of the cloth, or in anything made of skin, it is the leper's disease: let the priest see it.

title: Leviticus 13:50
text: And after it has been seen by the priest, the thing which is so marked is to be shut up for seven days:

title: Leviticus 13:51
text: And he is to see the mark on the seventh day; if the mark is increased in the clothing, or in the threads of the material, or in the leather, whatever the leather is used for, it is the disease biting into it: it is unclean.

title: Leviticus 13:52
text: And the clothing, or the wool or linen material, or anything of leather in which is the disease, is to be burned: for the disease is biting into it; let it be burned in the fire.

title: Leviticus 13:53
text: And if the priest sees that the mark is not increased in the clothing or in any part of the material or in the leather,

title: Leviticus 13:54
text: Then the priest will give orders for the thing on which the mark is, to be washed, and to be shut up for seven days more:

title: Leviticus 13:55
text: And if, after the mark has been washed, the priest sees that the colour of it is not changed and it is not increased, it is to be burned in the fire: the disease is working in it, though the damage may be inside or outside.

title: Leviticus 13:56
text: And if the priest sees that the mark is less bright after the washing, then let him have it cut out of the clothing or the leather or from the threads of the material:

title: Leviticus 13:57
text: And if the mark is still seen in the clothing or in the threads of the material or in the leather, it is the disease coming out: the thing in which the disease is will have to be burned with fire.

title: Leviticus 13:58
text: And the material of the clothing, or anything of skin, which has been washed, if the mark has gone out of it, let it be washed a second time and it will be clean.

title: Leviticus 13:59
text: This is the law about the leper's disease in the thread of wool or linen material, in clothing or in anything of skin, saying how it is to be judged clean or unclean.

title: Leviticus 14:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 14:2
text: This is the law of the leper on the day when he is made clean: he is to be taken to the priest;

title: Leviticus 14:3
text: And the priest is to go outside the tent-circle; and if, after looking, the priest sees that the mark of the disease has gone from him,

title: Leviticus 14:4
text: Then the priest is to give orders to take, for him who is to be made clean, two living clean birds and some cedar wood and red thread and hyssop.

title: Leviticus 14:5
text: And the priest will give orders for one of the birds to be put to death in a vessel made of earth, over flowing water.

title: Leviticus 14:6
text: And he will take the living bird and the wood and the red thread and the hyssop and put them in the blood of the bird which was put to death over flowing water.

title: Leviticus 14:7
text: And shaking it seven times over the man who is to be made clean, he will say that he is clean and will let the living bird go free into the open country.

title: Leviticus 14:8
text: And he who is to be made clean will have his clothing washed and his hair cut and have a bath, and he will be clean. And after that he will come back to the tent-circle; but he is to keep outside his tent for seven days.

title: Leviticus 14:9
text: And on the seventh day he is to have all the hair cut off his head and his chin and over his eyes--all his hair is to be cut off--and he will have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and he will be clean.

title: Leviticus 14:10
text: ¶And on the eighth day let him take two male lambs, without any marks on them, and one female lamb of the first year, without a mark, and three tenth parts of an ephah of the best meal, mixed with oil, and one log of oil.

title: Leviticus 14:11
text: And the priest who is making him clean will put the man who is being made clean, together with these things, before the door of the Tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 14:12
text: And the priest is to take one of the male lambs and give it as an offering for wrongdoing, and the log of oil, waving them for a wave offering before the Lord;

title: Leviticus 14:13
text: And he is to put the male lamb to death in the place where they put to death the sin-offering and the burned offering, in the holy place; for as the sin-offering is the property of the priest, so is the offering for wrongdoing: it is most holy.

title: Leviticus 14:14
text: And let the priest take some of the blood of the offering for wrongdoing and put it on the point of the right ear of him who is to be made clean, and on the thumb of his right hand and on the great toe of his right foot;

title: Leviticus 14:15
text: And take some of the oil and put it in the hollow of his left hand;

title: Leviticus 14:16
text: And let the priest put his right finger in the oil which is in his left hand, shaking it out with his finger seven times before the Lord;

title: Leviticus 14:17
text: And of the rest of the oil which is in his hand, the priest will put some on the point of the right ear of the man who is to be made clean, and on the thumb of his right hand and on the great toe of his right foot, over the blood of the offering for wrongdoing;

title: Leviticus 14:18
text: And the rest of the oil in the priest's hand he will put on the head of him who is to be made clean; and so the priest will make him free from sin before the Lord.

title: Leviticus 14:19
text: And the priest will give the sin-offering, and take away the sin of him who is to be made clean from his unclean condition; and after that he will put the burned offering to death.

title: Leviticus 14:20
text: And the priest is to have the burned offering and the meal offering burned on the altar; and the priest will take away his sin and he will be clean.

title: Leviticus 14:21
text: ¶And if he is poor and not able to get so much, then he may take one male lamb as an offering for wrongdoing, to be waved to take away his sin, and one tenth part of an ephah of the best meal mixed with oil for a meal offering, and a log of oil;

title: Leviticus 14:22
text: And two doves or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and one will be for a sin-offering and the other for a burned offering.

title: Leviticus 14:23
text: And on the eighth day he will take them to the priest, to the door of the Tent of meeting before the Lord, so that he may be made clean.

title: Leviticus 14:24
text: And the priest will take the lamb of the offering for wrongdoing and the oil, waving them for a wave offering before the Lord;

title: Leviticus 14:25
text: And he will put to death the lamb of the offering for wrongdoing and the priest will take some of the blood of the offering for wrongdoing and put it on the point of the right ear of him who is to be made clean, and on the thumb of his right hand and on the great toe of his right foot;

title: Leviticus 14:26
text: And the priest will put out some of the oil in the hollow of his left hand,

title: Leviticus 14:27
text: Shaking out drops of oil with his right finger before the Lord seven times:

title: Leviticus 14:28
text: And the priest will put some of the oil which is in his hand on the point of the ear of the man who is to be made clean and on the thumb of his right hand and on the great toe of his right foot, on the place where the blood of the offering for wrongdoing was put;

title: Leviticus 14:29
text: And the rest of the oil which is in the priest's hand he will put on the head of him who is to be made clean, to take away his sin before the Lord.

title: Leviticus 14:30
text: And he will make an offering of one of the doves or the young pigeons, such as he is able to get;

title: Leviticus 14:31
text: And of these, he will give one for a sin-offering and one for a burned offering, with the meal offering; and the priest will take away the sin of him who is to be made clean before the Lord.

title: Leviticus 14:32
text: This is the law for the man who has the disease of the leper on him, and who is not able to get that which is necessary for making himself clean.

title: Leviticus 14:33
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

title: Leviticus 14:34
text: When you have come into the land of Canaan which I will give you for your heritage, if I put the leper's disease on a house in the land of your heritage,

title: Leviticus 14:35
text: Then let the owner of the house come and say to the priest, It seems to me that there is a sort of leper's disease in the house.

title: Leviticus 14:36
text: And the priest will give orders for everything to be taken out of the house, before he goes in to see the disease, so that the things in the house may not become unclean; and then the priest is to go in to see the house;

title: Leviticus 14:37
text: And if he sees that the walls of the house are marked with hollows of green and red, and if it seems to go deeper than the face of the wall;

title: Leviticus 14:38
text: Then the priest will go out of the door of the house, and keep the house shut up for seven days:

title: Leviticus 14:39
text: And the priest is to come again on the seventh day and have a look and see if the marks on the walls of the house are increased in size;

title: Leviticus 14:40
text: Then the priest will give orders to them to take out the stones in which the disease is seen, and put them out into an unclean place outside the town:

title: Leviticus 14:41
text: And he will have the house rubbed all over inside, and the paste which is rubbed off will be put out into an unclean place outside the town:

title: Leviticus 14:42
text: And they will take other stones and put them in place of those stones, and he will take other paste and put it on the walls of the house.

title: Leviticus 14:43
text: And if the disease comes out again in the house after he has taken out the stones and after the walls have been rubbed and the new paste put on,

title: Leviticus 14:44
text: Then the priest will come and see it; and if the disease in the house is increased in size, it is the leper's disease working out in the house: it is unclean.

title: Leviticus 14:45
text: And the house will have to be pulled down, the stones of it and the wood and the paste; and everything is to be taken out to an unclean place outside the town.

title: Leviticus 14:46
text: And, in addition, anyone who goes into the house at any time, while it is shut up, will be unclean till evening.

title: Leviticus 14:47
text: And anyone who has been sleeping in the house will have to have his clothing washed; and anyone who takes food in that house will have to have his clothing washed.

title: Leviticus 14:48
text: And if the priest comes in, and sees that the disease is not increased after the new paste has been put on the house, then the priest will say that the house is clean, because the disease is gone.

title: Leviticus 14:49
text: And in order to make the house clean, let him take two birds and cedar-wood and red thread and hyssop;

title: Leviticus 14:50
text: And put one of the birds to death in a vessel of earth over flowing water;

title: Leviticus 14:51
text: And take the cedar-wood and the hyssop and the red thread and the living bird and put them in the blood of the dead bird and in the flowing water, shaking it over the house seven times.

title: Leviticus 14:52
text: And he will make the house clean with the blood of the bird and the flowing water and with the living bird and with the cedar-wood and the hyssop and the red thread.

title: Leviticus 14:53
text: But he will let the living bird go out of the town into the open country; so he will take away sin from the house and it will be clean.

title: Leviticus 14:54
text: ¶This is the law for all signs of the leper's disease and for skin diseases;

title: Leviticus 14:55
text: And for signs of disease in clothing, or in a house;

title: Leviticus 14:56
text: And for a growth or a bad place or a bright mark on the skin;

title: Leviticus 14:57
text: To make clear when it is unclean and when it is clean: this is the law about the disease of the leper.

title: Leviticus 15:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses and to Aaron,

title: Leviticus 15:2
text: Say to the children of Israel: If a man has an unclean flow from his flesh, it will make him unclean.

title: Leviticus 15:3
text: If the flow goes on or if the part is stopped up, to keep back the flow, he is still unclean.

title: Leviticus 15:4
text: Every bed on which he has been resting will be unclean, and everything on which he has been seated will be unclean.

title: Leviticus 15:5
text: And anyone touching his bed is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

title: Leviticus 15:6
text: And he who has been seated on anything on which the unclean man has been seated is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

title: Leviticus 15:7
text: And anyone touching the flesh of the unclean man is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

title: Leviticus 15:8
text: And if liquid from the mouth of the unclean man comes on to him who is clean, then he is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

title: Leviticus 15:9
text: And any leather seat on a horse on which the unclean man has been seated will be unclean.

title: Leviticus 15:10
text: And anyone touching anything which was under him will be unclean till the evening; anyone taking up any of these things is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

title: Leviticus 15:11
text: And anyone on whom the unclean man puts his hands, without washing them in water, is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

title: Leviticus 15:12
text: And any vessel of earth which has been touched by the unclean man will have to be broken and any vessel of wood washed.

title: Leviticus 15:13
text: And when a man who has a flow from his body is made clean from it, he is to take seven days to make himself clean, washing his clothing and bathing his body in flowing water, and then he will be clean.

title: Leviticus 15:14
text: And on the eighth day he is to take two doves or two young pigeons and come before the Lord to the door of the Tent of meeting and give them to the priest:

title: Leviticus 15:15
text: And they are to be offered by the priest, one for a sin-offering and one for a burned offering, and the priest will take away his sin before the Lord on account of his flow.

title: Leviticus 15:16
text: And if a man's seed goes out from him, then all his body will have to be bathed in water and he will be unclean till evening.

title: Leviticus 15:17
text: And any clothing or skin on which the seed comes is to be washed with water and be unclean till evening.

title: Leviticus 15:18
text: And if a man has sex relations with a woman and his seed goes out from him, the two of them will have to be bathed in water and will be unclean till evening.

title: Leviticus 15:19
text: ¶And if a woman has a flow of blood from her body, she will have to be kept separate for seven days, and anyone touching her will be unclean till evening.

title: Leviticus 15:20
text: And everything on which she has been resting, while she is kept separate, will be unclean, and everything on which she has been seated will be unclean.

title: Leviticus 15:21
text: And anyone touching her bed will have to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

title: Leviticus 15:22
text: And anyone touching anything on which she has been seated will have to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

title: Leviticus 15:23
text: Anyone touching anything on the bed or on the thing on which she has been seated, will be unclean till evening.

title: Leviticus 15:24
text: And if any man has sex relations with her so that her blood comes on him, he will be unclean for seven days and every bed on which he has been resting will be unclean.

title: Leviticus 15:25
text: And if a woman has a flow of blood for a long time, not at the time when she generally has it, or if the flow goes on longer than the normal time, she will be unclean while the flow of blood goes on, as she is at other normal times.

title: Leviticus 15:26
text: Every bed on which she has been resting will be unclean, as at the times when she normally has a flow of blood, and everything on which she has been seated will be unclean, in the same way.

title: Leviticus 15:27
text: And anyone touching these things will be unclean, and his clothing will have to be washed and his body bathed in water and he will be unclean till evening.

title: Leviticus 15:28
text: But when her flow of blood is stopped, after seven days she will be clean.

title: Leviticus 15:29
text: And on the eighth day let her get two doves or two young pigeons and take them to the priest to the door of the Tent of meeting,

title: Leviticus 15:30
text: To be offered by the priest, one for a sin-offering and one for a burned offering; and the priest will take away her sin before the Lord on account of her unclean condition.

title: Leviticus 15:31
text: In this way may the children of Israel be made free from all sorts of unclean conditions, so that death may not overtake them when they are unclean and when they make unclean my holy place which is among them.

title: Leviticus 15:32
text: This is the law for the man who has a flow from his body, or whose seed goes from him so that he is unclean;

title: Leviticus 15:33
text: And for her who has a flow of blood, and for any man or woman who has an unclean flow, and for him who has sex relations with a woman when she is unclean.

title: Leviticus 16:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses, after the death of the two sons of Aaron when they took in strange fire before the Lord and death overtook them;

title: Leviticus 16:2
text: The Lord said to Moses, Say to Aaron, your brother, that he may not come at all times into the holy place inside the veil, before the cover which is on the ark, for fear that death may overtake him; for I will be seen in the cloud on the cover of the ark.

title: Leviticus 16:3
text: Let Aaron come into the holy place in this way: with an ox for a sin-offering and a male sheep for a burned offering.

title: Leviticus 16:4
text: Let him put on the holy linen coat, and the linen trousers on his body, and the linen band round him, and the linen head-dress on his head; for this is holy clothing, and before he puts them on his body is to be washed with water.

title: Leviticus 16:5
text: ¶And let him take from the children of Israel two he-goats for a sin-offering and one male sheep for a burned offering.

title: Leviticus 16:6
text: And Aaron is to give the ox of the sin-offering for himself, to make himself and his house free from sin.

title: Leviticus 16:7
text: And he is to take the two goats and put them before the Lord at the door of the Tent of meeting.

title: Leviticus 16:8
text: And Aaron will make selection from the two goats by the decision of the Lord, one goat for the Lord and one for Azazel.

title: Leviticus 16:9
text: And the goat which is marked out for the Lord, let Aaron give for a sin-offering.

title: Leviticus 16:10
text: But the goat for Azazel is to be placed living before the Lord, for the taking away of sin, that it may be sent away for Azazel into the waste land.

title: Leviticus 16:11
text: And Aaron is to give the ox of the sin-offering for himself and take away sin from himself and his house, and put to death the ox of the sin-offering which is for himself.

title: Leviticus 16:12
text: And he is to take a vessel full of burning coal from the altar before the Lord and in his hand some sweet perfume crushed small, and take it inside the veil;

title: Leviticus 16:13
text: And let him put the perfume on the fire before the Lord so that the ark may be covered with a cloud of the smoke of the perfume, in order that death may not overtake him.

title: Leviticus 16:14
text: And let him take some of the blood of the ox, shaking drops of it from his finger on the cover of the ark on the east side, and before it, seven times.

title: Leviticus 16:15
text: ¶Then let him put to death the goat of the sin-offering for the people, and take its blood inside the veil and do with it as he did with the blood of the ox, shaking drops of it on and before the cover of the ark.

title: Leviticus 16:16
text: And let him make the holy place free from whatever is unclean among the children of Israel and from their wrongdoing in all their sins; and let him do the same for the Tent of meeting, which has its place among an unclean people.

title: Leviticus 16:17
text: And no man may be in the Tent of meeting from the time when Aaron goes in to take away sin in the holy place till he comes out, having made himself and his house and all the people of Israel free from sin.

title: Leviticus 16:18
text: And he is to go out to the altar which is before the Lord and make it free from sin; and he is to take some of the blood of the ox and the blood of the goat and put it on the horns of the altar and round it;

title: Leviticus 16:19
text: Shaking drops of the blood from his finger on it seven times to make it holy and clean from whatever is unclean among the children of Israel.

title: Leviticus 16:20
text: ¶And when he has done whatever is necessary to make the holy place and the Tent of meeting and the altar free from sin, let him put the living goat before the Lord;

title: Leviticus 16:21
text: And Aaron, placing his two hands on the head of the living goat, will make a public statement over him of all the evil doings of the children of Israel and all their wrongdoing, in all their sins; and he will put them on the head of the goat and send him away, in the care of a man who will be waiting there, into the waste land.

title: Leviticus 16:22
text: And the goat will take all their sins into a land cut off from men, and he will send the goat away into the waste land.

title: Leviticus 16:23
text: Then let Aaron come into the Tent of meeting and take off the linen clothing which he put on when he went into the holy place, and put them down there;

title: Leviticus 16:24
text: And after bathing his body in water in a holy place, he is to put on his clothing and come out and give his burned offering and the burned offering of the people, to take away his sin and the sin of the people.

title: Leviticus 16:25
text: And the fat of the sin-offering is to be burned by him on the altar.

title: Leviticus 16:26
text: And the man who takes away the goat for Azazel is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and then he may come back to the tent-circle.

title: Leviticus 16:27
text: And the ox of the sin-offering and the goat of the sin-offering, whose blood was taken in to make the holy place free from sin, are to be taken away outside the tent-circle and their skins and their flesh and their waste are to be burned with fire.

title: Leviticus 16:28
text: And the man by whom they are burned is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water, and then he may come back to the tent-circle.

title: Leviticus 16:29
text: ¶And let this be an order to you for ever: in the seventh month, on the tenth day, you are to keep yourselves from pleasure and do no sort of work, those who are Israelites by birth and those from other lands who are living among you:

title: Leviticus 16:30
text: For on this day your sin will be taken away and you will be clean: you will be made free from all your sins before the Lord.

title: Leviticus 16:31
text: It is a special Sabbath for you, and you are to keep yourselves from pleasure; it is an order for ever.

title: Leviticus 16:32
text: And the man on whose head the holy oil has been put, and who has been marked out to be a priest in his father's place, will do what is necessary to take away sin, and will put on the linen clothing, even the holy robes:

title: Leviticus 16:33
text: And he will make the holy place and the Tent of meeting and the altar free from sin; he will take away sin from the priests and from all the people.

title: Leviticus 16:34
text: And let this be an order for ever for you, so that the sin of the children of Israel may be taken away once every year. And he did as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

title: Leviticus 17:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 17:2
text: Say to Aaron and to his sons and to all the children of Israel: This is the order which the Lord has given.

title: Leviticus 17:3
text: If any man of Israel puts to death an ox or a lamb or a goat, in or outside the tent-circle;

title: Leviticus 17:4
text: And has not taken it to the door of the Tent of meeting, to make an offering to the Lord, before the Lord's House, its blood will be on him, for he has taken life, and he will be cut off from among his people:

title: Leviticus 17:5
text: So that the children of Israel may take to the Lord, to the door of the Tent of meeting and to the priest, the offerings which they have put to death in the open country, and that they may make their peace-offerings to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 17:6
text: And the priest will put blood on the altar of the Lord at the door of the Tent of meeting, burning the fat for a sweet smell to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 17:7
text: And let them make no more offerings to evil spirits, after which they have gone, turning away from the Lord. Let this be a law to them for ever, through all their generations.

title: Leviticus 17:8
text: And say to them, If any man of Israel, or any other living among them, makes a burned offering or other offering,

title: Leviticus 17:9
text: And does not take it to the door of the Tent of meeting to make an offering to the Lord, that man will be cut off from among his people.

title: Leviticus 17:10
text: ¶And if any man of Israel, or any other living among them, takes any sort of blood for food, my wrath will be turned against that man and he will be cut off from among his people.

title: Leviticus 17:11
text: For the life of the flesh is in its blood; and I have given it to you on the altar to take away your sin: for it is the blood which makes free from sin because of the life in it.

title: Leviticus 17:12
text: For this reason I have said to the children of Israel, No man among you, or any others living with you, may take blood as food.

title: Leviticus 17:13
text: And any man of Israel, or any other living among them, who gets with his bow any beast or bird used for food, is to see that its blood is covered with earth.

title: Leviticus 17:14
text: For the blood is the life of all flesh: and so I have said to the children of Israel, You may not take any sort of blood as food, and any man who does so will be cut of.

title: Leviticus 17:15
text: And anyone who takes as food anything which has come to a natural end, or anything which has been put to death by beasts, if he is one of you by birth, or of another nation, will have to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening, and then he will be clean.

title: Leviticus 17:16
text: But if his clothing is not washed and his body bathed, his sin will be on him.

title: Leviticus 18:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 18:2
text: Say to the children of Israel, I am the Lord your God.

title: Leviticus 18:3
text: You may not do those things which were done in the land of Egypt where you were living; and you may not do those things which are done in the land of Canaan where I am taking you, or be guided in your behaviour by their rules.

title: Leviticus 18:4
text: But you are to be guided by my decisions and keep my rules, and be guided by them: I am the Lord your God.

title: Leviticus 18:5
text: So keep my rules and my decisions, which, if a man does them, will be life to him: I am the Lord.

title: Leviticus 18:6
text: ¶You may not have sex connection with anyone who is a near relation: I am the Lord.

title: Leviticus 18:7
text: You may not have sex relations with your father or your mother: she is your mother, you may not take her.

title: Leviticus 18:8
text: And you may not have sex relations with your father's wife: she is your father's.

title: Leviticus 18:9
text: You may not take your sister, the daughter of your father or of your mother, wherever her birth took place, among you or in another country.

title: Leviticus 18:10
text: You may not have sex relations with your son's daughter or your daughter's daughter, for they are part of yourself;

title: Leviticus 18:11
text: Or your father's wife's daughter, the child of your father, for she is your sister.

title: Leviticus 18:12
text: You may not have sex connection with your father's sister, for she is your father's near relation.

title: Leviticus 18:13
text: You may not have sex connection with your mother's sister, for she is your mother's near relation.

title: Leviticus 18:14
text: You may not have sex relations with the wife of your father's brother, for she is of your family;

title: Leviticus 18:15
text: Or with your daughter-in-law, for she is your son's wife, and you may not take her.

title: Leviticus 18:16
text: You may not have sex relations with your brother's wife, for she is your brother's.

title: Leviticus 18:17
text: You may not take as wife a woman and her daughter, or her son's daughter or her daughter's daughter, for they are of one family: it is an act of shame.

title: Leviticus 18:18
text: And you may not take as wife a woman and at the same time her sister, to be in competition with her in her life-time.

title: Leviticus 18:19
text: ¶And you may not go near a woman or have sex relations with her when she is unclean, at her regular time.

title: Leviticus 18:20
text: And you may not have sex relations with your neighbour's wife, making yourself unclean with her.

title: Leviticus 18:21
text: And you may not make any of your children go through the fire as an offering to Molech, and you may not put shame on the name of your God: I am the Lord.

title: Leviticus 18:22
text: You may not have sex relations with men, as you do with women: it is a disgusting thing.

title: Leviticus 18:23
text: And you may not have sex relations with a beast, making yourself unclean with it; and a woman may not give herself to a beast: it is an unnatural act.

title: Leviticus 18:24
text: Do not make yourself unclean in any of these ways; for so have those nations whom I am driving out from before you made themselves unclean:

title: Leviticus 18:25
text: And the land itself has become unclean; so that I have sent on it the reward of its wrongdoing, and the land itself puts out those who are living in it.

title: Leviticus 18:26
text: So then keep my rules and my decisions, and do not do any of these disgusting things, those of you who are Israelites by birth, or any others who are living with you:

title: Leviticus 18:27
text: (For all these disgusting things were done by the men of this country who were there before you, and the land has been made unclean by them;)

title: Leviticus 18:28
text: So that the land may not put you out from it, when you make it unclean, as it put out the nations which were there before you.

title: Leviticus 18:29
text: For all those who do any of these disgusting things will be cut off from among their people.

title: Leviticus 18:30
text: So then, keep my orders, so that you may not do any of these disgusting things which were done before you, or make yourselves unclean through them: I am the Lord your God.

title: Leviticus 19:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 19:2
text: Say to all the people of Israel, You are to be holy, for I, the Lord your God, am holy.

title: Leviticus 19:3
text: Let every man give honour to his mother and to his father and keep my Sabbaths: I am the Lord your God.

title: Leviticus 19:4
text: Do not go after false gods, and do not make metal images of gods for yourselves: I am the Lord your God.

title: Leviticus 19:5
text: And when you give a peace offering to the Lord, do it in the way which is pleasing to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 19:6
text: Let it be used for food on the same day on which it is offered, or on the day after; and whatever is over on the third day is to be burned with fire.

title: Leviticus 19:7
text: If any of it is used for food on the third day, it is a disgusting thing and will not be pleasing to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 19:8
text: And as for anyone who takes it for food, his sin will be on him, for he has put shame on the holy thing of the Lord: he will be cut off from his people.

title: Leviticus 19:9
text: And when you get in the grain from your land, do not let all the grain be cut from the edges of the field, or take up what has been dropped on the earth after the getting in of the grain.

title: Leviticus 19:10
text: And do not take all the grapes from your vine-garden, or the fruit dropped on the earth; let the poor man, and the man from another country, have these: I am the Lord your God.

title: Leviticus 19:11
text: ¶Do not take anyone's property or be false in act or word to another.

title: Leviticus 19:12
text: And do not take an oath in my name falsely, putting shame on the name of your God: I am the Lord.

title: Leviticus 19:13
text: Do not be cruel to your neighbour or take what is his; do not keep back a servant's payment from him all night till the morning.

title: Leviticus 19:14
text: Do not put a curse on those who have no hearing, or put a cause of falling in the way of the blind, but keep the fear of your God before you: I am the Lord.

title: Leviticus 19:15
text: Do no wrong in your judging: do not give thought to the position of the poor, or honour to the position of the great; but be a judge to your neighbour in righteousness.

title: Leviticus 19:16
text: Do not go about saying untrue things among your people, or take away the life of your neighbour by false witness: I am the Lord.

title: Leviticus 19:17
text: Let there be no hate in your heart for your brother; but you may make a protest to your neighbour, so that he may be stopped from doing evil.

title: Leviticus 19:18
text: Do not make attempts to get equal with one who has done you wrong, or keep hard feelings against the children of your people, but have love for your neighbour as for yourself: I am the Lord.

title: Leviticus 19:19
text: ¶Keep my laws. Do not let your cattle have offspring by those of a different sort; do not put mixed seed into your field; do not put on a robe made of two sorts of cloth.

title: Leviticus 19:20
text: If any man has sex relations with a servant-woman who has given her word to be married to a man, and has not been made free for a price or in any other way, the thing will be looked into; but they will not be put to death because she was not a free woman.

title: Leviticus 19:21
text: Let him take his offering for wrongdoing to the Lord, to the door of the Tent of meeting; let him give a male sheep as an offering for wrongdoing.

title: Leviticus 19:22
text: And the priest will take away his sin before the Lord with the sheep which is offered for his wrongdoing, and he will have forgiveness for the sin which he has done.

title: Leviticus 19:23
text: And when you have come into the land, and have put in all sorts of fruit-trees, their fruit will be as if they had not had circumcision, and for three years their fruit may not be used for food.

title: Leviticus 19:24
text: And in the fourth year all the fruit will be holy as a praise-offering to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 19:25
text: But in the fifth year you may take the fruit and the increase of it for your food: I am the Lord your God.

title: Leviticus 19:26
text: Nothing may be used for food with its blood in it; you may not make use of strange arts, or go in search of signs and wonders.

title: Leviticus 19:27
text: The ends of the hair round your face and on your chin may not be cut off.

title: Leviticus 19:28
text: You may not make cuts in your flesh in respect for the dead, or have marks printed on your bodies: I am the Lord.

title: Leviticus 19:29
text: Do not make your daughter common by letting her become a loose woman, for fear that the land may become full of shame.

title: Leviticus 19:30
text: ¶Keep my Sabbaths and have respect for my holy place: I am the Lord.

title: Leviticus 19:31
text: Do not go after those who make use of spirits, or wonder-workers; do not go in their ways or become unclean through them: I am the Lord your God.

title: Leviticus 19:32
text: Get up from your seats before the white-haired, and give honour to the old, and let the fear of your God be before you: I am the Lord.

title: Leviticus 19:33
text: And if a man from another country is living in your land with you, do not make life hard for him;

title: Leviticus 19:34
text: Let him be to you as one of your countrymen and have love for him as for yourself; for you were living in a strange land, in the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.

title: Leviticus 19:35
text: Do not make false decisions in questions of yard-sticks and weights and measures.

title: Leviticus 19:36
text: Have true scales, true weights and measures for all things: I am the Lord your God, who took you out of the land of Egypt;

title: Leviticus 19:37
text: You are to keep all my rules and my decisions and do them: I am the Lord.

title: Leviticus 20:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 20:2
text: Again, say to the children of Israel, If any man of the children of Israel, or any other man living in Israel, gives his offspring to Molech, he is certainly to be put to death: he is to be stoned by the people of the land;

title: Leviticus 20:3
text: And my face will be turned against that man, and he will be cut off from his people; because he has given his offspring to Molech, making my holy place unclean, and making my holy name common.

title: Leviticus 20:4
text: And if the people of the land do not take note of that man when he gives his offspring to Molech, and do not put him to death,

title: Leviticus 20:5
text: Then my face will be turned against him and his family, and he and all those who do evil with him will be cut off from among their people.

title: Leviticus 20:6
text: And whoever goes after those who make use of spirits and wonder-workers, doing evil with them, against him will my face be turned, and he will be cut off from among his people.

title: Leviticus 20:7
text: So make and keep yourselves holy, for I am the Lord your God.

title: Leviticus 20:8
text: And keep my rules and do them: I am the Lord, who make you holy.

title: Leviticus 20:9
text: Every man cursing his father or his mother is certainly to be put to death; because of his curse on his father or his mother, his blood will be on him.

title: Leviticus 20:10
text: ¶And if a man has sex relations with another man's wife, even the wife of his neighbour, he and she are certainly to be put to death.

title: Leviticus 20:11
text: And the man who has sex relations with his father's wife has put shame on his father: the two of them are to be put to death; their blood will be on them.

title: Leviticus 20:12
text: And if a man has sex relations with his son's wife, the two of them are to be put to death: it is unnatural; their blood will be on them.

title: Leviticus 20:13
text: And if a man has sex relations with a man, the two of them have done a disgusting thing: let them be put to death; their blood will be on them.

title: Leviticus 20:14
text: And if a man takes as wife a woman and her mother, it is an act of shame; let them be burned with fire, all three of them, so that there may be no shame among you.

title: Leviticus 20:15
text: And if a man has sex relations with a beast, let him be put to death, and let the beast be put to destruction.

title: Leviticus 20:16
text: And if a woman goes near a beast and has sex relations with it, you will put an end to the woman and the beast: their blood will be on them.

title: Leviticus 20:17
text: And if a man takes his sister, daughter of his father or his mother, and has sex relations with her and she with him, it is an act of shame: they are to be cut off before the children of their people; he has had sex relations with his sister, and his sin will be on him.

title: Leviticus 20:18
text: And if a man has sex relations with a woman at the time when she is unwell, he has seen her fountain and she has let the fountain of her blood be uncovered, and the two of them are to be cut off from among their people.

title: Leviticus 20:19
text: And you may not have sex connection with your mother's sister or your father's sister, for they are his near relations: their sin will be on them.

title: Leviticus 20:20
text: And if a man has sex relations with the wife of his father's brother, he has put shame on his father's brother: their sin will be on them; till the day of their death they will have no children.

title: Leviticus 20:21
text: And if a man takes his brother's wife, it is an unclean act; he has put shame on his brother; they will have no children.

title: Leviticus 20:22
text: ¶So then, keep my rules and my decisions and do them, so that the land which I am giving you as your resting-place may not violently send you out again.

title: Leviticus 20:23
text: And do not keep the rules of the nations which I am driving out before you; for they did all these things, and for that reason my soul was turned against them.

title: Leviticus 20:24
text: But I have said to you, You will take their land and I will give it to you for your heritage, a land flowing with milk and honey: I am the Lord your God who have made you separate from all other peoples.

title: Leviticus 20:25
text: So then, make division between the clean beast and the unclean, and between the clean bird and the unclean: do not make yourselves disgusting by any beast or bird or anything which goes flat on the earth, which has been marked by me as unclean for you.

title: Leviticus 20:26
text: And you are to be holy to me; for I the Lord am holy and have made you separate from the nations, so that you may be my people.

title: Leviticus 20:27
text: Any man or woman who makes use of spirits, or who is a wonder-worker, is to be put to death: they are to be stoned with stones: their blood will be on them.

title: Leviticus 21:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses, Say to the priests, the sons of Aaron, Let no man make himself unclean for the dead among his people;

title: Leviticus 21:2
text: But only for his near relations, for his mother or his father, his son or his daughter, and his brother;

title: Leviticus 21:3
text: And for his sister, a virgin, for she is his near relation and has had no husband, he may make himself unclean.

title: Leviticus 21:4
text: But let him, being a chief among his people, not make himself unclean in such a way as to put shame on himself.

title: Leviticus 21:5
text: They are not to have their hair cut off for the dead, or the hair on their chins cut short, or make cuts in their flesh.

title: Leviticus 21:6
text: Let them be holy to their God and not make the name of their God common; for the fire offerings of the Lord and the bread of their God are offered by them, and they are to be holy.

title: Leviticus 21:7
text: They may not take as wife a loose or common woman, or one who has been put away by her husband: for the priest is holy to his God.

title: Leviticus 21:8
text: And he is to be holy in your eyes, for by him the bread of your God is offered; he is to be holy in your eyes, for I the Lord, who make you holy, am holy.

title: Leviticus 21:9
text: And if the daughter of a priest makes herself common and by her loose behaviour puts shame on her father, let her be burned with fire.

title: Leviticus 21:10
text: ¶And he who is the chief priest among his brothers, on whose head the holy oil has been put, who is marked out to put on the holy robes, may not let his hair go loose or have his clothing out of order as a sign of sorrow.

title: Leviticus 21:11
text: He may not go near any dead body or make himself unclean for his father or his mother;

title: Leviticus 21:12
text: He may not go out of the holy place or make the holy place of his God common; for the crown of the holy oil of his God is on him: I am the Lord.

title: Leviticus 21:13
text: And let him take as his wife one who has not had relations with a man.

title: Leviticus 21:14
text: A widow, or one whose husband has put her away, or a common woman of loose behaviour, may not be the wife of a priest; but let him take a virgin from among his people.

title: Leviticus 21:15
text: And he may not make his seed unclean among his people, for I the Lord have made him holy.

title: Leviticus 21:16
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 21:17
text: Say to Aaron, If a man of your family, in any generation, is damaged in body, let him not come near to make the offering of the bread of his God.

title: Leviticus 21:18
text: For any man whose body is damaged may not come near: one who is blind, or has not the use of his legs, or one who has a broken nose or any unnatural growth,

title: Leviticus 21:19
text: Or a man with broken feet or hands,

title: Leviticus 21:20
text: Or one whose back is bent, or one who is unnaturally small, or one who has a damaged eye, or whose skin is diseased, or whose sex parts are damaged;

title: Leviticus 21:21
text: No man of the offspring of Aaron whose body is damaged in any way may come near to give the fire offerings of the Lord: he is damaged, he may not come near to make the offerings.

title: Leviticus 21:22
text: He may take of the bread of God, the holy and the most holy;

title: Leviticus 21:23
text: But he may not go inside the veil or come near the altar, because he is damaged; and he may not make my holy places common; for I the Lord have made them holy.

title: Leviticus 21:24
text: These are the words which Moses said to Aaron and to his sons and to all the children of Israel.

title: Leviticus 22:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 22:2
text: Give orders to Aaron and to his sons to keep themselves separate from the holy things of the children of Israel which they give to me, and not to make my holy name common: I am the Lord,

title: Leviticus 22:3
text: Say to them, If any man of all your seed through all your generations, being unclean, comes near the holy things which the children of Israel make holy to the Lord, he will be cut off from before me: I am the Lord.

title: Leviticus 22:4
text: No man of the seed of Aaron who is a leper, or who has a flow from his body, may take of the holy food till he is clean. And any man touching anything which is unclean because of the dead, or any man whose seed goes from him;

title: Leviticus 22:5
text: Or anyone touching any unclean thing which goes flat on the earth, or someone by whom he may be made unclean in any way whatever;

title: Leviticus 22:6
text: Any person touching any such unclean thing will be unclean till evening, and may not take of the holy food till his flesh has been bathed in water;

title: Leviticus 22:7
text: And when the sun has gone down he will be clean; and after that he may take part in the holy food, because it is his bread.

title: Leviticus 22:8
text: That which comes to a natural death, or is attacked by beasts, he may not take as food, for it will make him unclean: I am the Lord.

title: Leviticus 22:9
text: So then, let them keep what I have put into their care, for fear that sin may come on them because of it, so causing their death because they have made it common: I am the Lord, who make them holy.

title: Leviticus 22:10
text: ¶No outside person may take of the holy food, or one living as a guest in the priest's house, or a servant working for payment.

title: Leviticus 22:11
text: But any person for whom the priest has given money, to make him his, may take of it with him; and those who come to birth in his house may take of his bread.

title: Leviticus 22:12
text: And if the daughter of a priest is married to an outside person she may not take of the holy things which are lifted up as offerings.

title: Leviticus 22:13
text: But if a priest's daughter is a widow, or parted from her husband, and has no child, and has come back to her father's house as when she was a girl, she may take of her father's bread; but no outside person may do so.

title: Leviticus 22:14
text: And if a man takes the holy food in error, he will have to give the holy thing back to the priest, with the addition of a fifth part.

title: Leviticus 22:15
text: And they may not make common the holy things which the children of Israel give to the Lord,

title: Leviticus 22:16
text: So causing sin to come on them when they take their holy things for food: I am the Lord who make them holy.

title: Leviticus 22:17
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 22:18
text: Say to Aaron and to his sons and to all the children of Israel, If any man of the children of Israel, or of another nation living in Israel, makes an offering, given because of an oath or freely given to the Lord for a burned offering;

title: Leviticus 22:19
text: So that it may be pleasing to the Lord, let him give a male, without any mark, from among the oxen or the sheep or the goats.

title: Leviticus 22:20
text: But anything which has a mark you may not give; it will not make you pleasing to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 22:21
text: And whoever makes a peace-offering to the Lord, in payment of an oath or as a free offering, from the herd or the flock, if it is to be pleasing to the Lord, let it be free from any mark or damage.

title: Leviticus 22:22
text: Anything blind or broken or damaged or having any disease or any mark on it may not be offered to the Lord; you may not make an offering of it by fire on the altar to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 22:23
text: An ox or a lamb which has more or less than its natural parts, may be given as a free offering; but it will not be taken in payment of an oath.

title: Leviticus 22:24
text: An animal which has its sex parts damaged or crushed or broken or cut, may not be offered to the Lord; such a thing may not be done anywhere in your land.

title: Leviticus 22:25
text: And from one who is not an Israelite you may not take any of these for an offering to the Lord; for they are unclean, there is a mark on them, and the Lord will not be pleased with them.

title: Leviticus 22:26
text: And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 22:27
text: When an ox or a sheep or a goat is given birth, let it be with its mother for seven days; and after the eighth day it may be taken as an offering made by fire to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 22:28
text: A cow or a sheep may not be put to death with its young on the same day.

title: Leviticus 22:29
text: And when you make an offering of praise to the Lord, make it in a way which is pleasing to him.

title: Leviticus 22:30
text: Let it be used for food on the same day; do not keep any part of it till the morning: I am the Lord.

title: Leviticus 22:31
text: So then, keep my orders and do them: I am the Lord.

title: Leviticus 22:32
text: And do not make my holy name common; so that it may be kept holy by the children of Israel: I am the Lord who make you holy,

title: Leviticus 22:33
text: Who took you out of the land of Egypt that I might be your God: I am the Lord.

title: Leviticus 23:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 23:2
text: Say to the children of Israel, These are the fixed feasts of the Lord, which you will keep for holy meetings: these are my feasts.

title: Leviticus 23:3
text: On six days work may be done; but the seventh day is a special day of rest, a time for worship; you may do no sort of work: it is a Sabbath to the Lord wherever you may be living.

title: Leviticus 23:4
text: ¶These are the fixed feasts of the Lord, the holy days of worship which you will keep at their regular times.

title: Leviticus 23:5
text: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at nightfall, is the Lord's Passover;

title: Leviticus 23:6
text: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread; for seven days let your food be unleavened bread.

title: Leviticus 23:7
text: On the first day you will have a holy meeting; you may do no sort of field-work.

title: Leviticus 23:8
text: And every day for seven days you will give a burned offering to the Lord; and on the seventh day there will be a holy meeting; you may do no field-work.

title: Leviticus 23:9
text: And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 23:10
text: Say to the children of Israel, When you have come to the land which I will give you, and have got in the grain from its fields, take some of the first-fruits of the grain to the priest;

title: Leviticus 23:11
text: And let the grain be waved before the Lord, so that you may be pleasing to him; on the day after the Sabbath let it be waved by the priest.

title: Leviticus 23:12
text: And on the day of the waving of the grain, you are to give a male lamb of the first year, without any mark, for a burned offering to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 23:13
text: And let the meal offering with it be two tenth parts of an ephah of the best meal mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to the Lord for a sweet smell; and the drink offering with it is to be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.

title: Leviticus 23:14
text: And you may take no bread or dry grain or new grain for food till the very day on which you have given the offering for your God: this is a rule for ever through all your generations wherever you are living.

title: Leviticus 23:15
text: ¶And let seven full weeks be numbered from the day after the Sabbath, the day when you give the grain for the wave offering;

title: Leviticus 23:16
text: Let fifty days be numbered, to the day after the seventh Sabbath; then you are to give a new meal offering to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 23:17
text: Take from your houses two cakes of bread, made of a fifth part of an ephah of the best meal, cooked with leaven, to be waved for first-fruits to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 23:18
text: And with the bread, take seven lambs of the first year, without any marks, and one ox and two male sheep, to be a burned offering to the Lord, with their meal offering and their drink offerings, an offering of a sweet smell made by fire to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 23:19
text: And you are to give one male goat for a sin-offering and two male lambs of the first year for peace-offerings.

title: Leviticus 23:20
text: And these will be waved by the priest, with the bread of the first-fruits, for a wave offering to the Lord, with the two lambs: they will be holy to the Lord for the priest.

title: Leviticus 23:21
text: And on the same day, let it be given out that there will be a holy meeting for you: you may do no field-work on that day: it is a rule for ever through all your generations wherever you are living.

title: Leviticus 23:22
text: And when you get in the grain from your land, do not let all the grain at the edges of the field be cut, and do not take up the grain which has been dropped in the field; let that be for the poor, and for the man from another country: I am the Lord your God.

title: Leviticus 23:23
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 23:24
text: Say to the children of Israel, In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, let there be a special day of rest for you, a day of memory, marked by the blowing of horns, a meeting for worship.

title: Leviticus 23:25
text: Do no field-work and give to the Lord an offering made by fire.

title: Leviticus 23:26
text: And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 23:27
text: The tenth day of this seventh month is the day for the taking away of sin; let it be a holy day of worship; you are to keep from pleasure, and give to the Lord an offering made by fire.

title: Leviticus 23:28
text: And on that day you may do no sort of work, for it is a day of taking away sin, to make you clean before the Lord your God.

title: Leviticus 23:29
text: For any person, whoever he may be, who takes his pleasure on that day will be cut off from his people.

title: Leviticus 23:30
text: And if any person, whoever he may be, on that day does any sort of work, I will send destruction on him from among his people.

title: Leviticus 23:31
text: You may not do any sort of work: this is an order for ever through all your generations wherever you may be living.

title: Leviticus 23:32
text: Let this be a Sabbath of special rest to you, and keep yourselves from all pleasure; on the ninth day of the month at nightfall from evening to evening, let this Sabbath be kept.

title: Leviticus 23:33
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 23:34
text: Say to the children of Israel, On the fifteenth day of this seventh month let the feast of tents be kept to the Lord for seven days.

title: Leviticus 23:35
text: On the first day there will be a holy meeting: do no field-work.

title: Leviticus 23:36
text: Every day for seven days give an offering made by fire to the Lord; and on the eighth day there is to be a holy meeting, when you are to give an offering made by fire to the Lord; this is a special holy day: you may do no field-work on that day.

title: Leviticus 23:37
text: These are the fixed feasts of the Lord, to be kept by you as holy days of worship, for making an offering by fire to the Lord; a burned offering, a meal offering, an offering of beasts, and drink offerings; every one on its special day;

title: Leviticus 23:38
text: In addition to the Sabbaths of the Lord, and in addition to the things you give and the oaths you make and the free offerings to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 23:39
text: But on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have got in all the fruits of the land, you will keep the feast of the Lord for seven days: the first day will be a Sabbath, and the eighth day the same.

title: Leviticus 23:40
text: On the first day, take the fruit of fair trees, branches of palm-trees, and branches of thick trees and trees from the riverside, and be glad before the Lord for seven days.

title: Leviticus 23:41
text: And let this feast be kept before the Lord for seven days in the year: it is a rule for ever from generation to generation; in the seventh month let it be kept.

title: Leviticus 23:42
text: For seven days you will be living in tents; all those who are Israelites by birth are to make tents their living-places:

title: Leviticus 23:43
text: So that future generations may keep in mind how I gave the children of Israel tents as their living-places when I took them out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.

title: Leviticus 23:44
text: And Moses made clear to the children of Israel the orders about the fixed feasts of the Lord.

title: Leviticus 24:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 24:2
text: Give orders to the children of Israel to give you clean olive oil for the light, so that a light may be burning at all times,

title: Leviticus 24:3
text: Outside the veil of the ark in the Tent of meeting; let Aaron see that it is burning from evening till morning at all times before the Lord: it is a rule for ever through all your generations.

title: Leviticus 24:4
text: Let Aaron put the lights in order on the support before the Lord at all times.

title: Leviticus 24:5
text: And take the best meal and make twelve cakes of it, a fifth part of an ephah in every cake.

title: Leviticus 24:6
text: And put them in two lines, six in a line, on the holy table before the Lord.

title: Leviticus 24:7
text: And on the lines of cakes put clean sweet-smelling spices, for a sign on the bread, an offering made by fire to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 24:8
text: Every Sabbath day regularly, the priest is to put it in order before the Lord: it is offered for the children of Israel, an agreement made for ever.

title: Leviticus 24:9
text: And it will be for Aaron and his sons; they are to take it for food in a holy place: it is the most holy of all the offerings made by fire to the Lord, a rule for ever.

title: Leviticus 24:10
text: ¶And a son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel and had a fight with a man of Israel by the tents;

title: Leviticus 24:11
text: And the son of the Israelite woman said evil against the holy Name, with curses; and they took him to Moses. His mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

title: Leviticus 24:12
text: And they kept him shut up, till a decision might be given by the mouth of the Lord.

title: Leviticus 24:13
text: And the Lord said to Moses,

title: Leviticus 24:14
text: Take the curser outside the tent-circle; and let all in whose hearing the words were said put their hands on his head, and let him be stoned by all the people.

title: Leviticus 24:15
text: And say to the children of Israel, As for any man cursing God, his sin will be on his head.

title: Leviticus 24:16
text: And he who says evil against the name of the Lord will certainly be put to death; he will be stoned by all the people; the man who is not of your nation and one who is an Israelite by birth, whoever says evil against the holy Name is to be put to death.

title: Leviticus 24:17
text: And anyone who takes another's life is certainly to be put to death.

title: Leviticus 24:18
text: And anyone wounding a beast and causing its death, will have to make payment for it: a life for a life.

title: Leviticus 24:19
text: And if a man does damage to his neighbour, as he has done, so let it be done to him;

title: Leviticus 24:20
text: Wound for wound, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; whatever damage he has done, so let it be done to him.

title: Leviticus 24:21
text: He who puts a beast to death will have to make payment for it; he who puts a man to death will himself be put to death.

title: Leviticus 24:22
text: You are to have the same law for a man of another nation living among you as for an Israelite; for I am the Lord your God.

title: Leviticus 24:23
text: And Moses said these words to the children of Israel, and they took the man who had been cursing outside the tent-circle and had him stoned. The children of Israel did as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

title: Leviticus 25:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to Moses on Mount Sinai,

title: Leviticus 25:2
text: Say to the children of Israel, When you come into the land which I will give you, let the land keep a Sabbath to the Lord.

title: Leviticus 25:3
text: For six years put seed into your land, and for six years give care to your vines and get in the produce of them;

title: Leviticus 25:4
text: But let the seventh year be a Sabbath of rest for the land, a Sabbath to the Lord; do not put seed into your land or have your vines cut.

title: Leviticus 25:5
text: That which comes to growth of itself may not be cut, and the grapes of your uncared-for vines may not be taken off; let it be a year of rest for the land.

title: Leviticus 25:6
text: And the Sabbath of the land will give food for you and your man-servant and your woman-servant and those working for payment, and for those of another country who are living among you;

title: Leviticus 25:7
text: And for your cattle and the beasts on the land; all the natural increase of the land will be for food.

title: Leviticus 25:8
text: ¶And let seven Sabbaths of years be numbered to you, seven times seven years; even the days of seven Sabbaths of years, that is forty-nine years;

title: Leviticus 25:9
text: Then let the loud horn be sounded far and wide on the tenth day of the seventh month; on the day of taking away sin let the horn be sounded through all your land.

title: Leviticus 25:10
text: And let this fiftieth year be kept holy, and say publicly that everyone in the land is free from debt: it is the Jubilee, and every man may go back to his heritage and to his family.

title: Leviticus 25:11
text: Let this fiftieth year be the Jubilee: no seed may be planted, and that which comes to growth of itself may not be cut, and the grapes may not be taken from the uncared-for vines.

title: Leviticus 25:12
text: For it is the Jubilee, and it is holy to you; your food will be the natural increase of the field.

title: Leviticus 25:13
text: In this year of Jubilee, let every man go back to his heritage.

title: Leviticus 25:14
text: And in the business of trading goods for money, do no wrong to one another.

title: Leviticus 25:15
text: Let your exchange of goods with your neighbours have relation to the number of years after the year of Jubilee, and the number of times the earth has given her produce.

title: Leviticus 25:16
text: If the number of years is great, the price will be increased, and if the number of years is small, the price will be less, for it is the produce of a certain number of years which the man is giving you.

title: Leviticus 25:17
text: And do no wrong, one to another, but let the fear of your God be before you; for I am the Lord your God.

title: Leviticus 25:18
text: So keep my rules and my decisions and do them, and you will be safe in your land.

title: Leviticus 25:19
text: And the land will give her fruit, and you will have food in full measure and be safe in the land.

title: Leviticus 25:20
text: And if you say, Where will our food come from in the seventh year, when we may not put in seed, or get in the increase

title: Leviticus 25:21
text: Then I will send my blessing on you in the sixth year, and the land will give fruit enough for three years.

title: Leviticus 25:22
text: And in the eighth year you will put in your seed, and get your food from the old stores, till the fruit of the ninth year is ready.

title: Leviticus 25:23
text: ¶No exchange of land may be for ever, for the land is mine, and you are as my guests, living with me for a time.
